model.whyline_denver_dbt.stg_denver_cras.name: stg_denver_crashes
model.whyline_denver_dbt.stg_denver_cras.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='view') }}

with base as (
    select
        crash_id,
        event_ts_utc,
        severity,
        severity_text,
        lon,
        lat,
        roadway_name,
        on_route,
        off_route,
        bike_involved,
        ped_involved,
        _extract_date,
        _ingested_at
    from {{ source('raw', 'raw_crashes') }}
    where lon is not null
      and lat is not null
      -- Only the latest extract: Denver's five-year window as of that day. Older extracts would
      -- keep crashes that have aged out of the window. raw_crashes is partitioned by event date,
      -- so this subquery reads only recent partitions; the main scan still covers every extract.
      and _extract_date = (
          select max(_extract_date)
          from {{ source('raw', 'raw_crashes') }}
          where event_ts_utc >= timestamp_sub(current_timestamp(), interval 60 day)
      )
),
deduped as (
    select
        *,
        row_number() over (
            partition by crash_id
            -- A crash listed twice in one extract: the latest load wins, fully ordered so reruns agree
            order by _extract_date desc, _ingested_at desc, event_ts_utc desc, severity desc, lon, lat
        ) as crash_rank
    from base
)
select
    crash_id,
    event_ts_utc,
    severity,
    severity_text,
    {{ make_point('lon', 'lat') }} as geom,
    roadway_name,
    on_route,
    off_route,
    bike_involved,
    ped_involved,
    {{ date_mst('event_ts_utc') }} as event_date_mst,
    {{ hour_mst('event_ts_utc') }} as event_hour_mst
from deduped
where crash_rank = 1

model.whyline_denver_dbt.fct_segment_tra.name: fct_segment_traversal
model.whyline_denver_dbt.fct_segment_tra.description: Running time between consecutive stops of a trip, both ends timed to within 30 s: from leaving stop n (middle of its departure window, or its arrival when it didn't stop) to reaching stop n+1, with distance along the shape, speed and scheduled time. Speeds over 130 km/h are dropped as timing error. Rebuildable from fct_stop_visit.
model.whyline_denver_dbt.fct_segment_tra.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized='incremental',
    incremental_strategy='insert_overwrite',
    partition_by={'field': 'service_date', 'data_type': 'date'},
    cluster_by=['route_id', 'from_stop_id'],
    on_schema_change='append_new_columns'
) }}

{#
Running time between consecutive stops of a trip: from leaving stop n (the middle of its
departure window, or its arrival when the vehicle didn't stop) to reaching stop n+1. Both ends
must be timed to within 30 s, and speeds over 130 km/h (faster than any RTD vehicle) are timing
error and dropped. Distance is along the trip's shape, so speed is the vehicle's average between
the stops, dwell excluded. Rebuildable from fct_stop_visit; nightly runs
replace the last segment_days service dates.
#}
{% set days = var('segment_days', 3) %}
{% if is_incremental() %}
    {% set first = "date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval " ~ days ~ " day)" %}
{% else %}
    {% set first = "date '" ~ var('segment_start', '2026-10-29') ~ "'" %}
{% endif %}
{% set last = "date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day)" %}

with visits as (
    select
        service_date,
        trip_id,
        route_id,
        direction_id,
        stop_sequence,
        stop_id,
        within_30s,
        stop_dist_m,
        arrival_ts_utc,
        if(
            stop_role != 'first' and departure_earliest_ts is not null,
            timestamp_add(
                departure_earliest_ts,
                interval (div(timestamp_diff(departure_latest_ts, departure_earliest_ts, second), 2)) second
            ),
            arrival_ts_utc
        ) as depart_ts_utc,
        coalesce(scheduled_departure_ts, scheduled_arrival_ts) as scheduled_depart_ts,
        coalesce(scheduled_arrival_ts, scheduled_departure_ts) as scheduled_arrive_ts
    from {{ ref('fct_stop_visit') }}
    where service_date between {{ first }} and {{ last }}
),
pairs as (
    select
        *,
        lead(stop_sequence) over trip_order as to_stop_sequence,
        lead(stop_id) over trip_order as to_stop_id,
        lead(within_30s) over trip_order as to_within_30s,
        lead(stop_dist_m) over trip_order as to_stop_dist_m,
        lead(arrival_ts_utc) over trip_order as arrive_ts_utc,
        lead(scheduled_arrive_ts) over trip_order as to_scheduled_arrive_ts
    from visits
    window trip_order as (partition by service_date, trip_id order by stop_sequence)
)

select
    service_date,
    trip_id,
    route_id,
    direction_id,
    stop_sequence as from_stop_sequence,
    stop_id as from_stop_id,
    to_stop_sequence,
    to_stop_id,
    case format_date('%u', service_date)
        when '6' then 'saturday'
        when '7' then 'sunday'
        else 'weekday'
    end as day_type,
    {{ hour_mst('depart_ts_utc') }} as depart_hour_mst,
    depart_ts_utc,
    arrive_ts_utc,
    timestamp_diff(arrive_ts_utc, depart_ts_utc, second) as travel_sec,
    timestamp_diff(to_scheduled_arrive_ts, scheduled_depart_ts, second) as scheduled_travel_sec,
    to_stop_dist_m - stop_dist_m as distance_m,
    round(safe_divide(3.6 * (to_stop_dist_m - stop_dist_m), timestamp_diff(arrive_ts_utc, depart_ts_utc, second)), 1)
        as speed_kmh
from pairs
where
    within_30s
    and to_within_30s
    and route_id is not null
    and to_stop_dist_m > stop_dist_m
    -- Whole seconds, so a sub-second traversal can't divide by zero.
    and timestamp_diff(arrive_ts_utc, depart_ts_utc, second) > 0
    -- Timing error on stops a few seconds apart yields impossible speeds (0.7% over 120 km/h).
    and safe_divide(3.6 * (to_stop_dist_m - stop_dist_m), timestamp_diff(arrive_ts_utc, depart_ts_utc, second)) <= 130

    and safe_divide(3.6 * (to_stop_dist_m - stop_dist_m), timestamp_diff(arrive_ts_utc, depart_ts_utc, second)) <= 130

model.whyline_denver_dbt.bridge_stop_tra.name: bridge_stop_tract
model.whyline_denver_dbt.bridge_stop_tra.description: Current stops x tracts within 804.672 m; weighting_factor is each tract's population share and sums to 1 per stop.
model.whyline_denver_dbt.bridge_stop_tra.raw_code:
{#
Many-to-many between current stops and the census tracts within 804.672 m (half a mile, a
standard walkable catchment). weighting_factor is each tract's share of the population
around the stop (latest ACS vintage, tracts with population only); it sums to 1 per stop.
#}
with stops as (
    select stop_key, stop_id, geom
    from {{ ref('dim_stop') }}
    where is_current
),
tracts as (
    select tract_key, geoid, geom
    from {{ ref('dim_tract') }}
    where tract_key != -1
),
latest_acs as (
    select geoid, acs_year, pop_total
    from {{ ref('fct_tract_demographics') }}
    qualify row_number() over (partition by geoid order by acs_year desc) = 1
),
near as (
    select
        s.stop_key,
        s.stop_id,
        t.tract_key,
        t.geoid
    from stops as s
    join tracts as t
        on st_dwithin(s.geom, t.geom, 804.672)
)

select
    n.stop_key,
    n.stop_id,
    n.tract_key,
    n.geoid,
    a.acs_year,
    a.pop_total as tract_pop_total,
    a.pop_total / sum(a.pop_total) over (partition by n.stop_key) as weighting_factor
from near as n
join latest_acs as a
    using (geoid)
where a.pop_total > 0

model.whyline_denver_dbt.dim_block_group.description: Type 1: Denver census block groups (2020) with Colorado EnviroScreen 2.0 percentile and disproportionately impacted community type (CDPHE), and Denver's DOTI equity score (higher means more need) and group rank (1 highest need, 6 lowest). Unknown member at key -1.
model.whyline_denver_dbt.dim_block_group.raw_code:
{#
Type 1: Denver census block groups (2020) with the state's and city's equity measures.
- Colorado EnviroScreen 2.0 (CDPHE): the EnviroScreen percentile within Colorado, and the
  disproportionately impacted community type under Colorado law (N/A when not impacted).
- Denver DOTI equity index: the score (16-68 in 2026; higher means more need) and group rank
  (1 is the highest-need group, 6 the lowest).
#}
with enviroscreen as (
    select
        json_value(properties_json, '$.GEOID') as geoid,
        safe_cast(json_value(properties_json, '$.ES_S_') as float64) as enviroscreen_pctl,
        nullif(json_value(properties_json, '$.DIType'), 'N/A') as di_community_type,
        geom
    from {{ ref('stg_arcgis_reference') }}
    where layer = 'enviroscreen_block_group'
    qualify row_number() over (partition by geoid order by object_id) = 1
),
doti as (
    -- One block group (080319800011, the airport) comes in two parts; merge them.
    select
        json_value(properties_json, '$.GEOID20') as geoid,
        max(safe_cast(json_value(properties_json, '$.EquityScore') as int64)) as doti_equity_score,
        min(safe_cast(json_value(properties_json, '$.EquityGroupRank') as int64)) as doti_equity_group_rank,
        st_union_agg(geom) as geom
    from {{ ref('stg_arcgis_reference') }}
    where layer = 'denver_doti_equity'
    group by 1
)

select
    farm_fingerprint(coalesce(e.geoid, d.geoid)) as block_group_key,
    coalesce(e.geoid, d.geoid) as geoid,
    substr(coalesce(e.geoid, d.geoid), 1, 11) as tract_geoid,
    e.enviroscreen_pctl,
    e.di_community_type,
    e.di_community_type is not null as is_disproportionately_impacted,
    d.doti_equity_score,
    d.doti_equity_group_rank,
    coalesce(e.geom, d.geom) as geom
from enviroscreen as e
full join doti as d
    on d.geoid = e.geoid
where coalesce(e.geoid, d.geoid) is not null
union all
select
    -1, cast(null as string), cast(null as string), cast(null as float64), cast(null as string), false,
    cast(null as int64), cast(null as int64), cast(null as geography)

model.whyline_denver_dbt.fct_trip_status.name: fct_trip_status
model.whyline_denver_dbt.fct_trip_status.description: One trip instance per service date x trip_id as the stream poller closed it: final relationship, outcome, first/last seen and visit counts by method.
model.whyline_denver_dbt.fct_trip_status.compiled_code:
with batch as (
    select *
    from `whyline-denver`.`stg_denver`.`stg_rt_trip_status`
    where service_date >= date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day)
    
      and data_version != 'backfill_v1'
      
      and _ingested_at >= timestamp_sub(current_timestamp(), interval 6 hour)
      
    
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by service_date, trip_id order by closed_at desc, _ingested_at desc
    ) = 1
),
new_trips as (
    select b.*
    from batch as b
    
    where not exists (
        select 1
        from `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`fct_trip_status` as f
        where f.service_date >= date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day)
          and f.service_date = b.service_date
          and f.trip_id = b.trip_id
    )
    
)

select
    t.service_date,
    t.trip_id,
    coalesce(dt.trip_key, -1) as trip_key,
    coalesce(dr.route_key, -1) as route_key,
    t.route_id,
    t.direction_id,
    t.final_schedule_relationship,
    t.outcome,
    t.first_seen_ts,
    t.last_seen_ts,
    t.first_vp_ts,
    t.last_vp_ts,
    t.had_vehicle,
    t.n_stops_static,
    t.n_visits,
    t.n_shape_crossing,
    t.n_last_prediction,
    t.n_skipped,
    t.data_version,
    t.static_md5,
    t._ingested_at
from new_trips as t
left join `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`dim_trip` as dt
    on dt.trip_id = t.trip_id
    and t.service_date between dt.valid_from and dt.valid_to
left join `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`dim_route` as dr
    on dr.route_id = t.route_id
    and t.service_date between dr.valid_from and dr.valid_to

model.whyline_denver_dbt.fct_stream_heal.name: fct_stream_health
model.whyline_denver_dbt.fct_stream_heal.description: Realtime coverage per 15-minute UTC window: distinct vehicle-feed updates the stream recorded (RTD publishes about every 30 seconds, so 30 is complete). is_healthy means at least 24; windows with no data have 0. Kept permanently.
model.whyline_denver_dbt.fct_stream_heal.compiled_code:
with updates as (
    select
        timestamp_seconds(div(unix_seconds(feed_ts_utc), 900) * 900) as window_start_utc,
        count(distinct feed_ts_utc) as n_feed_updates
    from `whyline-denver`.`stg_denver`.`stg_rt_vehicle_positions`
    where feed_ts_utc >= timestamp(date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 3 day))
    group by 1
),
windows as (
    select window_start_utc
    from unnest(generate_timestamp_array(
        timestamp(date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 3 day)), timestamp_sub(current_timestamp(), interval 15 minute), interval 15 minute
    )) as window_start_utc
)

select
    cast(w.window_start_utc as date) as window_date_utc,
    w.window_start_utc,
    coalesce(u.n_feed_updates, 0) as n_feed_updates,
    coalesce(u.n_feed_updates, 0) >= 24 as is_healthy
from windows as w
left join updates as u
    on u.window_start_utc = w.window_start_utc

model.whyline_denver_dbt.fct_trip_occupa.name: fct_trip_occupancy
model.whyline_denver_dbt.fct_trip_occupa.description: The highest occupancy RTD reported on the way to, or at, each stop of each trip: one row per stop visit (n_reports = 0 where nothing was reported). Levels 1 many seats, 2 few seats, 3 standing room only, 4 crushed standing room only, 5 full; NO_DATA_AVAILABLE is no data. Kept permanently; raw reports expire after 90 days.
model.whyline_denver_dbt.fct_trip_occupa.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized='incremental',
    incremental_strategy='insert_overwrite',
    partition_by={'field': 'service_date', 'data_type': 'date'},
    cluster_by=['route_id', 'stop_id'],
    on_schema_change='append_new_columns',
    full_refresh=false
) }}

{#
Crowding: the highest occupancy RTD reported on the way to, or at, each stop of each trip. One
row per stop visit; stops with no report keep n_reports = 0. A vehicle report counts toward its
stop_id, at the first occurrence at or ahead of the vehicle's progress along the shape (50 m
slack, as the poller uses), so loop routes that pass a stop twice resolve.

Levels: 1 many seats (or empty), 2 few seats, 3 standing room only, 4 crushed standing room
only, 5 full. NO_DATA_AVAILABLE and missing values are no data. Only some vehicles report, and
RTD sets the thresholds. Raw reports expire after 90 days, so full refresh is disabled.
#}
{% set days = var('crowding_days', 3) %}
{% if is_incremental() %}
    {% set first = "date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval " ~ days ~ " day)" %}
{% else %}
    {% set first = "date '" ~ var('crowding_start', '2026-10-29') ~ "'" %}
{% endif %}
{% set last = "date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day)" %}

with visits as (
    select
        service_date,
        trip_id,
        stop_sequence,
        stop_id,
        stop_role,
        route_id,
        direction_id,
        stop_dist_m,
        -- The first stop's arrival holds its departure; skipped stops fall back to the schedule.
        coalesce(arrival_ts_utc, scheduled_arrival_ts) as event_ts_utc
    from {{ ref('fct_stop_visit') }}
    where service_date between {{ first }} and {{ last }}
),
reports as (
    select
        service_date,
        trip_id,
        vehicle_id,
        report_ts_utc,
        stop_id,
        dist_along_m,
        case occupancy_status
            when 'EMPTY' then 1
            when 'MANY_SEATS_AVAILABLE' then 1
            when 'FEW_SEATS_AVAILABLE' then 2
            when 'STANDING_ROOM_ONLY' then 3
            when 'CRUSHED_STANDING_ROOM_ONLY' then 4
            when 'FULL' then 5
        end as level
    from {{ ref('stg_rt_vehicle_positions') }}
    where
        -- Constant bounds so BigQuery prunes the raw partitions (see fct_prediction_accuracy).
        feed_ts_utc >= timestamp({{ first }})
        and feed_ts_utc < timestamp(date_add({{ last }}, interval 2 day))
        and valid_for_timing
        and stop_id is not null
),
matched as (
    select
        r.service_date,
        r.trip_id,
        v.stop_sequence,
        r.report_ts_utc,
        r.level
    from reports as r
    join visits as v
        on v.service_date = r.service_date
        and v.trip_id = r.trip_id
        and v.stop_id = r.stop_id
        and v.stop_dist_m >= r.dist_along_m - 50
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by r.service_date, r.trip_id, r.vehicle_id, r.report_ts_utc
        order by v.stop_sequence
    ) = 1
),
by_stop as (
    select
        service_date,
        trip_id,
        stop_sequence,
        count(*) as n_reports,
        countif(level is not null) as n_reports_with_data,
        max(level) as max_level,
        min(report_ts_utc) as first_report_ts
    from matched
    group by 1, 2, 3
)

select
    v.service_date,
    v.trip_id,
    v.stop_sequence,
    v.stop_id,
    v.stop_role,
    v.route_id,
    v.direction_id,
    v.event_ts_utc,
    coalesce(b.n_reports, 0) as n_reports,
    coalesce(b.n_reports_with_data, 0) as n_reports_with_data,
    b.max_level,
    case b.max_level
        when 1 then 'many_seats'
        when 2 then 'few_seats'
        when 3 then 'standing_room_only'
        when 4 then 'crushed_standing_room_only'
        when 5 then 'full'
    end as max_level_label,
    b.first_report_ts
from visits as v
left join by_stop as b
    on b.service_date = v.service_date
    and b.trip_id = v.trip_id
    and b.stop_sequence = v.stop_sequence

model.whyline_denver_dbt.bridge_stop_str.name: bridge_stop_street_safety
model.whyline_denver_dbt.bridge_stop_str.description: One row per current stop inside Denver with the street around it from Denver's open-data layers: High Injury Network within 30 m and its tier (1 has the highest crash rates), nearest traffic signal (NULL beyond 1 km), curb ramps within 50 m, existing bikeway within 100 m, transit lane within 20 m, transit signal priority or queue jump within 50 m.
model.whyline_denver_dbt.bridge_stop_str.raw_code:
{#
One row per current stop inside Denver with the street around it, from Denver's open-data layers
(weekly): the High Injury Network within 30 m (tier 1 has the highest crash rates), the nearest
traffic signal (NULL beyond 1 km), curb ramps within 50 m, an existing bikeway within 100 m, a
transit lane within 20 m, and transit signal priority or a queue jump within 50 m. Stops outside
Denver have no row: the layers cover only the city, so absence there isn't evidence.
#}
with layers as (
    select layer, properties_json, geom
    from {{ ref('stg_arcgis_reference') }}
    where geom is not null
),
denver as (
    select st_union_agg(geom) as geom
    from {{ ref('dim_tract') }}
    where geom is not null
),
stops as (
    select s.stop_id, s.geom
    from {{ ref('dim_stop') }} as s
    cross join denver as d
    where s.is_current and st_contains(d.geom, s.geom)
),
hin as (
    select s.stop_id, min(safe_cast(json_value(l.properties_json, '$.Tier') as int64)) as hin_tier
    from stops as s
    join layers as l
        on l.layer = 'denver_hin'
        and st_dwithin(s.geom, l.geom, 30)
    group by 1
),
signals as (
    select s.stop_id, min(st_distance(s.geom, l.geom)) as nearest_signal_m
    from stops as s
    join layers as l
        on l.layer = 'denver_traffic_signals'
        and st_dwithin(s.geom, l.geom, 1000)
    group by 1
),
ramps as (
    select s.stop_id, count(*) as n_curb_ramps_50m
    from stops as s
    join layers as l
        on l.layer = 'denver_curb_ramps'
        and st_dwithin(s.geom, l.geom, 50)
    group by 1
),
bikeways as (
    select distinct s.stop_id
    from stops as s
    join layers as l
        on l.layer = 'denver_bike_facilities'
        and starts_with(json_value(l.properties_json, '$.DISPLAY_STATUS'), 'Existing')
        and st_dwithin(s.geom, l.geom, 100)
),
lanes as (
    select distinct s.stop_id
    from stops as s
    join layers as l
        on l.layer = 'denver_transit_lanes'
        and st_dwithin(s.geom, l.geom, 20)
),
transit_signals as (
    select
        s.stop_id,
        logical_or(json_value(l.properties_json, '$.TSP') = 'Yes') as has_tsp,

model.whyline_denver_dbt.fct_alert.name: fct_alert
model.whyline_denver_dbt.fct_alert.description: One RTD service alert, kept permanently: first and last time it was in the feed, and its latest cause, effect and text.
model.whyline_denver_dbt.fct_alert.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized='incremental',
    incremental_strategy='merge',
    unique_key='alert_id',
    on_schema_change='append_new_columns',
    full_refresh=false
) }}

{#
Grain: one RTD service alert, kept permanently (raw snapshots expire after 90 days). first_seen
and last_seen bound when the alert was in the feed; cause, effect and text are the latest seen.
Nightly runs merge the last alerts_lookback_days of snapshots, keeping the earliest first_seen.
#}
{% set lookback = var('alerts_lookback_days', 3) %}

with batch as (
    select
        alert_id,
        min(feed_ts_utc) as first_seen_ts,
        max(feed_ts_utc) as last_seen_ts,
        array_agg(
            struct(cause, effect, header_text, description_text, url)
            order by feed_ts_utc desc limit 1
        )[offset(0)] as latest
    from {{ ref('stg_rt_alerts') }}
    where feed_ts_utc >= timestamp_sub(current_timestamp(), interval {{ lookback }} day)
    group by 1
)

select
    b.alert_id,
    {% if is_incremental() %}
    least(b.first_seen_ts, coalesce(f.first_seen_ts, b.first_seen_ts)) as first_seen_ts,
    {% else %}
    b.first_seen_ts,
    {% endif %}
    b.last_seen_ts,
    b.latest.cause,
    b.latest.effect,
    b.latest.header_text,
    b.latest.description_text,
    b.latest.url
from batch as b
{% if is_incremental() %}
left join {{ this }} as f
    on f.alert_id = b.alert_id
{% endif %}

model.whyline_denver_dbt.fct_scheduled_s.name: fct_scheduled_stop_time
model.whyline_denver_dbt.fct_scheduled_s.description: One scheduled stop per trip x stop_sequence x service date, from the GTFS extract current on that date.
model.whyline_denver_dbt.fct_scheduled_s.raw_code:
{{
    config(
        materialized='incremental',
        incremental_strategy='insert_overwrite',
        partition_by={'field': 'service_date_mst', 'data_type': 'date'},
        cluster_by=['trip_id', 'stop_id']
    )
}}

{#
Grain: one scheduled stop per trip x stop_sequence x service date.
Each date is expanded from the GTFS snapshot that was current on it (as-of join), so the
past keeps the schedule as published.
- A day's load is a usable snapshot only if every file loaded that day passed validation:
  the positional CSV load shifted columns on some days (2025-12-09 to 2026-01-04), and
  mixing that day's valid files with an older feed would pair mismatched trip ids.
- Each date uses the latest snapshot on or before it; if that snapshot's calendar has no
  service on the date (a new period first captured a day late), the next snapshot is used.
- The loader skips files whose content did not change, so each file then uses its latest
  valid extract on or before the chosen snapshot.
- Nightly incremental runs replace today through +lookahead, reading each file's most
  recent extract partitions (constant filter, so BigQuery prunes); a full refresh
  rebuilds from schedule_history_start.
#}
{% set lookahead_days = var('schedule_lookahead_days', 30) %}
{% set files = {
    'calendar': 'raw_gtfs_calendar',
    'calendar_dates': 'raw_gtfs_calendar_dates',
    'trips': 'raw_gtfs_trips',
    'stop_times': 'raw_gtfs_stop_times',
} %}
{% set extract_filter = {} %}
{% for name, table in files.items() %}
    {% if is_incremental() %}
        {% do extract_filter.update({name: recent_extracts_filter(source('raw', table), var('schedule_recent_extracts', 7))}) %}
    {% else %}
        {% do extract_filter.update({name: 'true'}) %}
    {% endif %}
{% endfor %}
{% if is_incremental() %}
    {% set start_date = "current_date('America/Denver')" %}
{% else %}
    {% set start_date = "date '" ~ var('schedule_history_start', '2025-10-23') ~ "'" %}
{% endif %}

with calendar as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_gtfs_calendar') }} where {{ extract_filter['calendar'] }}
),
calendar_dates as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_gtfs_calendar_dates') }} where {{ extract_filter['calendar_dates'] }}
),
trips as (
    select _extract_date, trip_id, route_id, direction_id, service_id, is_valid
    from {{ ref('stg_gtfs_trips') }}
    where {{ extract_filter['trips'] }}
),
stop_times as (
    select _extract_date, trip_id, stop_id, stop_sequence, arrival_time, departure_time, is_valid
    from {{ ref('stg_gtfs_stop_times') }}
    where {{ extract_filter['stop_times'] }}
),
file_extracts as (
    {%- for name in files %}
    select
        '{{ name }}' as gtfs_file,
        _extract_date,
        logical_and(is_valid) as all_valid,
        logical_or(is_valid) as any_valid
    from {{ name }}
    group by _extract_date
    {%- if not loop.last %}
    union all{% endif %}
    {%- endfor %}
),
good_snapshots as (
    select _extract_date
    from file_extracts
    group by _extract_date
    having logical_and(all_valid)
),
date_candidates as (
    select
        service_date,
        max(if(g._extract_date <= service_date, g._extract_date, null)) as prev_snapshot,
        min(if(g._extract_date > service_date, g._extract_date, null)) as next_snapshot
    from unnest(generate_date_array(
        {{ start_date }},
        date_add(current_date('America/Denver'), interval {{ lookahead_days }} day)
    )) as service_date
    cross join good_snapshots as g
    group by service_date
),
date_snapshot as (
    -- Preference 1: latest snapshot on or before the date; 2: the next one
    select
        dc.service_date,
        candidate.snapshot_date,
        candidate.preference
    from date_candidates as dc
    cross join unnest([
        struct(dc.prev_snapshot as snapshot_date, 1 as preference),
        struct(dc.next_snapshot as snapshot_date, 2 as preference)
    ]) as candidate
    where candidate.snapshot_date is not null
),
date_extract as (
    -- Per file: latest valid extract on or before the snapshot (unchanged files are not reloaded)
    select
        ds.service_date,
        ds.preference
        {%- for name in files %},
        coalesce(
            max(if(fe.gtfs_file = '{{ name }}' and fe.any_valid and fe._extract_date <= ds.snapshot_date, fe._extract_date, null)),
            min(if(fe.gtfs_file = '{{ name }}' and fe.any_valid, fe._extract_date, null))
        ) as {{ name }}_extract
        {%- endfor %}
    from date_snapshot as ds
    cross join file_extracts as fe
    group by ds.service_date, ds.preference
),
active_services as (
    select
        de.service_date,
        de.preference,
        de.trips_extract,
        de.stop_times_extract,
        c.service_id
    from date_extract as de
    join calendar as c
        on c._extract_date = de.calendar_extract
        and c.is_valid
        and de.service_date between c.start_date and c.end_date
        and case extract(dayofweek from de.service_date)
            when 1 then c.sunday
            when 2 then c.monday
            when 3 then c.tuesday
            when 4 then c.wednesday
            when 5 then c.thursday
            when 6 then c.friday
            when 7 then c.saturday
        end
    left join calendar_dates as removed
        on removed._extract_date = de.calendar_dates_extract
        and removed.service_id = c.service_id
        and removed.exception_date = de.service_date
        and removed.exception_type = 2
        and removed.is_valid
    where removed.service_id is null

    union distinct

    select
        de.service_date,
        de.preference,
        de.trips_extract,
        de.stop_times_extract,
        cd.service_id
    from date_extract as de
    join calendar_dates as cd
        on cd._extract_date = de.calendar_dates_extract
        and cd.exception_date = de.service_date
        and cd.exception_type = 1
        and cd.is_valid
),
chosen_services as (
    -- Use the next snapshot only when the preferred one runs no service that day
    select *
    from active_services
    qualify preference = min(preference) over (partition by service_date)
),
expanded as (
    select
        a.service_date,
        a.stop_times_extract,
        t.trip_id,
        t.route_id,
        t.direction_id,
        st.stop_id,
        st.stop_sequence,
        case
            when st.arrival_time is not null
                then {{ gtfs_time_to_ts('a.service_date', 'st.arrival_time') }}
        end as sched_arrival_ts_mst,
        case
            when st.departure_time is not null
                then {{ gtfs_time_to_ts('a.service_date', 'st.departure_time') }}
        end as sched_departure_ts_mst
    from chosen_services as a
    join trips as t
        on t._extract_date = a.trips_extract
        and t.service_id = a.service_id
        and t.is_valid
    join stop_times as st
        on st._extract_date = a.stop_times_extract
        and st.trip_id = t.trip_id
        and st.is_valid
)

select
    e.service_date as service_date_mst,
    e.trip_id,
    e.stop_id,
    e.stop_sequence,
    e.route_id,
    e.direction_id,
    coalesce(dt.trip_key, -1) as trip_key,
    coalesce(dr.route_key, -1) as route_key,
    coalesce(ds.stop_key, -1) as stop_key,
    e.sched_arrival_ts_mst,
    e.sched_departure_ts_mst,
    e.stop_times_extract as gtfs_extract_date
from expanded as e
left join {{ ref('dim_trip') }} as dt
    on dt.trip_id = e.trip_id
    and e.service_date between dt.valid_from and dt.valid_to
left join {{ ref('dim_route') }} as dr
    on dr.route_id = e.route_id
    and e.service_date between dr.valid_from and dr.valid_to
left join {{ ref('dim_stop') }} as ds
    on ds.stop_id = e.stop_id
    and e.service_date between ds.valid_from and ds.valid_to
where e.sched_arrival_ts_mst is not null or e.sched_departure_ts_mst is not null

model.whyline_denver_dbt.fct_alert_entit.raw_code:
{{ config(

    full_refresh=false
) }}

{#
Grain: one alert x informed entity (route, direction, stop, trip) x active period, kept
permanently. first_seen and last_seen say in which snapshots that combination appeared, so a
period RTD later edited stays as history; marts use the rows from the alert's last snapshot. An
alert without periods has one row per entity with NULL start and end: active while in the feed.
#}
{% set lookback = var('alerts_lookback_days', 3) %}

with entities as (
    select distinct feed_ts_utc, alert_id, route_id, route_type, direction_id, stop_id, trip_id
    from {{ ref('stg_rt_alerts') }}
    where feed_ts_utc >= timestamp_sub(current_timestamp(), interval {{ lookback }} day)
),
periods as (
    select distinct feed_ts_utc, alert_id, active_start_utc, active_end_utc
    from {{ ref('stg_rt_alert_periods') }}
    where feed_ts_utc >= timestamp_sub(current_timestamp(), interval {{ lookback }} day)
),
batch as (
    select
        farm_fingerprint(concat(
            e.alert_id, '|', coalesce(e.route_id, ''), '|', coalesce(cast(e.direction_id as string), ''), '|',
            coalesce(e.stop_id, ''), '|', coalesce(e.trip_id, ''), '|',
            coalesce(cast(p.active_start_utc as string), ''), '|', coalesce(cast(p.active_end_utc as string), '')
        )) as alert_entity_period_key,
        e.alert_id,
        e.route_id,
        e.route_type,
        e.direction_id,
        e.stop_id,
        e.trip_id,
        p.active_start_utc,
        p.active_end_utc,
        min(e.feed_ts_utc) as first_seen_ts,
        max(e.feed_ts_utc) as last_seen_ts
    from entities as e
    left join periods as p
        on p.feed_ts_utc = e.feed_ts_utc
        and p.alert_id = e.alert_id
    group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9
)

select
    b.alert_entity_period_key,
    b.alert_id,
    b.route_id,
    b.route_type,
    b.direction_id,
    b.stop_id,
    b.trip_id,
    b.active_start_utc,
    b.active_end_utc,
    {% if is_incremental() %}
    least(b.first_seen_ts, coalesce(f.first_seen_ts, b.first_seen_ts)) as first_seen_ts,
    {% else %}
    b.first_seen_ts,
    {% endif %}
    b.last_seen_ts
from batch as b
{% if is_incremental() %}
left join {{ this }} as f
    on f.alert_entity_period_key = b.alert_entity_period_key
{% endif %}

model.whyline_denver_dbt.fct_prediction_.name: fct_prediction_accuracy
model.whyline_denver_dbt.fct_prediction_.description: The arrival prediction riders saw 1, 3, 5, 10, 15, 20 and 30 minutes before each measured stop visit (shape crossing within 30 s), against the actual arrival. One row per service date x trip x stop_sequence x horizon. error_sec = actual - predicted; horizon_bucket is the countdown shown (countdown_sec) and within_band follows MBTA's published accuracy standard. Kept permanently; raw prediction history expires after 90 days.
model.whyline_denver_dbt.fct_prediction_.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized='incremental',
    incremental_strategy='insert_overwrite',
    partition_by={'field': 'service_date', 'data_type': 'date'},
    cluster_by=['route_id', 'stop_id'],
    on_schema_change='append_new_columns',
    full_refresh=false
) }}

{#
Arrival-prediction accuracy: for each stop visit timed from a shape crossing to within 30 s, the
prediction riders saw 1, 3, 5, 10, 15, 20 and 30 minutes before the vehicle actually arrived. That is
the latest stop-level prediction change at or before that moment; if it was a drop, marked the
stop skipped (no time), or nothing had been predicted yet, no prediction was on screen.

error_sec = actual - predicted: positive means the vehicle came later than predicted (a longer
wait), negative means earlier (a rider trusting the prediction could miss it). Buckets and bands
follow the MBTA's published standard: the bucket is the countdown shown (predicted - as of), and
a prediction is accurate within 1 min early to 1 min late at 0-3 min, 1.5/2 at 3-6, 2.5/3.5 at
6-12 and 4/6 at 12-30.

Raw prediction history expires after 90 days, so full refresh is disabled. Nightly runs replace
the last prediction_accuracy_days complete service dates; the first build starts at the stream.
#}
{% set days = var('prediction_accuracy_days', 3) %}
{% if is_incremental() %}
    {% set first = "date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval " ~ days ~ " day)" %}
{% else %}
    {% set first = "date '" ~ var('prediction_accuracy_start', '2026-10-29') ~ "'" %}
{% endif %}
{% set last = "date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day)" %}

with visits as (
    select
        service_date,
        trip_id,
        stop_sequence,
        stop_id,
        route_id,
        direction_id,
        arrival_method,
        arrival_ts_utc
    from {{ ref('fct_stop_visit') }}
    where
        service_date between {{ first }} and {{ last }}
        and arrival_method in ('shape_crossing', 'shape_crossing_gap')
        and within_30s
        and arrival_ts_utc is not null
),
horizons as (
    select horizon_min from unnest([1, 3, 5, 10, 15, 20, 30]) as horizon_min
),
targets as (
    select
        v.*,
        h.horizon_min,
        timestamp_sub(v.arrival_ts_utc, interval h.horizon_min minute) as as_of_ts
    from visits as v
    cross join horizons as h
),
changes as (
    select
        service_date,
        trip_id,
        stop_sequence,
        feed_ts_utc,
        change_type,
        predicted_ts_utc
    from {{ ref('stg_rt_prediction_changes') }}
    where
        not is_trip_level
        -- Constant bounds so BigQuery prunes the raw partitions. A service day runs from about
        -- 10:00 UTC to 10:00 UTC the next day; predictions start a few hours before a trip.
        and feed_ts_utc >= timestamp({{ first }})
        and feed_ts_utc < timestamp(date_add({{ last }}, interval 2 day))
),
as_of as (
    select
        t.*,
        c.change_type,
        c.predicted_ts_utc,
        c.feed_ts_utc as prediction_made_ts
    from targets as t
    left join changes as c
        on c.service_date = t.service_date
        and c.trip_id = t.trip_id
        and c.stop_sequence = t.stop_sequence
        and c.feed_ts_utc <= t.as_of_ts
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by t.service_date, t.trip_id, t.stop_sequence, t.horizon_min
        order by c.feed_ts_utc desc
    ) = 1
),
predicted as (
    select
        *,
        coalesce(change_type, 'dropped') != 'dropped' and predicted_ts_utc is not null as has_prediction
    from as_of
),
scored as (
    select
        *,
        if(has_prediction, timestamp_diff(predicted_ts_utc, as_of_ts, second), null) as countdown_sec,
        if(has_prediction, timestamp_diff(arrival_ts_utc, predicted_ts_utc, second), null) as error_sec
    from predicted
),
bucketed as (
    select
        *,
        -- With no prediction on screen, bucket by the true time to arrival instead.
        case
            when coalesce(countdown_sec, horizon_min * 60) < 180 then '0-3'
            when coalesce(countdown_sec, horizon_min * 60) < 360 then '3-6'
            when coalesce(countdown_sec, horizon_min * 60) < 720 then '6-12'
            else '12-30'
        end as horizon_bucket
    from scored
)

select
    service_date,
    trip_id,
    stop_sequence,
    stop_id,
    route_id,
    direction_id,
    horizon_min,
    horizon_bucket,
    has_prediction,
    if(has_prediction, prediction_made_ts, null) as prediction_made_ts,
    if(has_prediction, predicted_ts_utc, null) as predicted_arrival_ts,
    arrival_ts_utc as actual_arrival_ts,
    arrival_method,
    countdown_sec,
    error_sec,
    case horizon_bucket
        when '0-3' then error_sec between -60 and 60
        when '3-6' then error_sec between -90 and 120
        when '6-12' then error_sec between -150 and 210
        else error_sec between -240 and 360
    end as within_band
from bucketed

        feed_ts_utc,
        change_type,
        predicted_ts_utc
    from `whyline-denver`.`stg_denver`.`stg_rt_prediction_changes`
    where
        not is_trip_level
        -- Constant bounds so BigQuery prunes the raw partitions. A service day runs from about
        -- 10:00 UTC to 10:00 UTC the next day; predictions start a few hours before a trip.
        and feed_ts_utc >= timestamp(date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 3 day))
        and feed_ts_utc < timestamp(date_add(date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day), interval 2 day))
),
as_of as (
    select
        t.*,
        c.change_type,
        c.predicted_ts_utc,
        c.feed_ts_utc as prediction_made_ts
    from targets as t
    left join changes as c
        on c.service_date = t.service_date
        and c.trip_id = t.trip_id
        and c.stop_sequence = t.stop_sequence
        and c.feed_ts_utc <= t.as_of_ts
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by t.service_date, t.trip_id, t.stop_sequence, t.horizon_min
        order by c.feed_ts_utc desc
    ) = 1
),
predicted as (
    select
        *,
        coalesce(change_type, 'dropped') != 'dropped' and predicted_ts_utc is not null as has_prediction
    from as_of
),
scored as (
    select
        *,
        if(has_prediction, timestamp_diff(predicted_ts_utc, as_of_ts, second), null) as countdown_sec,
        if(has_prediction, timestamp_diff(arrival_ts_utc, predicted_ts_utc, second), null) as error_sec
    from predicted
),
bucketed as (
    select
        *,
        -- With no prediction on screen, bucket by the true time to arrival instead.
        case
            when coalesce(countdown_sec, horizon_min * 60) < 180 then '0-3'
            when coalesce(countdown_sec, horizon_min * 60) < 360 then '3-6'
            when coalesce(countdown_sec, horizon_min * 60) < 720 then '6-12'
            else '12-30'
        end as horizon_bucket
    from scored
)

select
    service_date,
    trip_id,
    stop_sequence,
    stop_id,
    route_id,
    direction_id,
    horizon_min,
    horizon_bucket,
    has_prediction,
    if(has_prediction, prediction_made_ts, null) as prediction_made_ts,
    if(has_prediction, predicted_ts_utc, null) as predicted_arrival_ts,
    arrival_ts_utc as actual_arrival_ts,
    arrival_method,
    countdown_sec,
    error_sec,
    case horizon_bucket
        when '0-3' then error_sec between -60 and 60
        when '3-6' then error_sec between -90 and 120
        when '6-12' then error_sec between -150 and 210
        else error_sec between -240 and 360
    end as within_band
from bucketed

model.whyline_denver_dbt.fct_stop_visit.name: fct_stop_visit
model.whyline_denver_dbt.fct_stop_visit.description: One stop visit per service date x trip x stop_sequence from the continuous stream (stream_v1) or the backfill (backfill_v1); every row is final. arrival_* hold the departure for the trip's first stop. delay_sec is NULL when unknown. Grain, method rules and uncertainty: docs/technical/plans/realtime-stop-visits.md.
model.whyline_denver_dbt.fct_stop_visit.raw_code:
{#
Grain: one stop visit per service date x trip x stop_sequence, kept permanently (raw expires
after 90 days, so full refreshes are disabled). The poller emits only final visits, so this is
insert-only: each run takes rows loaded in the last stop_visit_lookback_hours (raw is
partitioned by load hour) and drops keys the fact already holds. The anti-join reads key
columns only and the MERGE then matches nothing, so no partition is rewritten.
Normal runs merge service dates from yesterday to today (Denver), which is what the poller
finalizes; older rows wait in raw for a run with a wider stop_visit_service_days.
The one-off backfill load runs with stop_visit_backfill=true and stream_start_date set.
Service date comes from GTFS start_date, so trips past midnight belong to the day they began.
#}
{% set backfill = var('stop_visit_backfill', false) %}
{% set stream_start = var('stream_start_date', '2100-01-01') %}
{% set service_days = var('stop_visit_service_days', 1) %}
{% if backfill %}
    {% set service_bound = "service_date < date '" ~ stream_start ~ "'" %}
{% else %}
    {% set service_bound = "service_date >= date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval " ~ service_days ~ " day)" %}
{% endif %}
{{
    config(
        materialized='incremental',
        incremental_strategy='merge',
        unique_key=['service_date', 'trip_id', 'stop_sequence'],
        partition_by={'field': 'service_date', 'data_type': 'date'},
        cluster_by=['route_id', 'stop_id'],
        incremental_predicates=['DBT_INTERNAL_DEST.' ~ service_bound],
        on_schema_change='append_new_columns',
        full_refresh=false
    )
}}

with batch as (
    select *
    from {{ ref('stg_rt_stop_visits') }}
    where {{ service_bound }}
    {% if backfill %}
      and data_version = 'backfill_v1'
    {% else %}
      and data_version != 'backfill_v1'
      {% if is_incremental() %}
      and _ingested_at >= timestamp_sub(current_timestamp(), interval {{ var('stop_visit_lookback_hours', 6) }} hour)
      {% endif %}
    {% endif %}
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by service_date, trip_id, stop_sequence
        order by emitted_at desc, _ingested_at desc
    ) = 1
),
new_visits as (
    select b.*
    from batch as b
    {% if is_incremental() %}
    where not exists (
        select 1
        from {{ this }} as f
        where f.{{ service_bound }}
          and f.service_date = b.service_date
          and f.trip_id = b.trip_id
          and f.stop_sequence = b.stop_sequence
    )
    {% endif %}
),
schedule as (
    -- Same service-date bound as the batch, so BigQuery prunes the schedule partitions.
    select
        service_date_mst as service_date,
        trip_id,
        stop_sequence,
        stop_id,
        route_id,
        direction_id,
        trip_key,
        route_key,
        stop_key,
        sched_arrival_ts_mst,
        sched_departure_ts_mst,
        timestamp_diff(
            coalesce(sched_arrival_ts_mst, sched_departure_ts_mst),
            lag(coalesce(sched_arrival_ts_mst, sched_departure_ts_mst)) over (
                partition by service_date_mst, route_id, direction_id, stop_id
                order by coalesce(sched_arrival_ts_mst, sched_departure_ts_mst), trip_id
            ),
            second
        ) as scheduled_headway_sec
    from {{ ref('fct_scheduled_stop_time') }}
    where {{ service_bound | replace('service_date', 'service_date_mst') }}
      and service_date_mst <= current_date('America/Denver')
),
conformed as (
    select
        v.*,
        s.trip_key,
        s.route_key,
        s.stop_key,
        s.sched_arrival_ts_mst as scheduled_arrival_ts,
        s.sched_departure_ts_mst as scheduled_departure_ts,
        s.scheduled_headway_sec,
        -- The origin's event is its departure; elsewhere, the arrival.
        if(
            v.stop_role = 'first',
            coalesce(s.sched_departure_ts_mst, s.sched_arrival_ts_mst),
            coalesce(s.sched_arrival_ts_mst, s.sched_departure_ts_mst)
        ) as scheduled_event_ts
    from new_visits as v
    left join schedule as s
        on s.service_date = v.service_date
        and s.trip_id = v.trip_id
        and s.stop_sequence = v.stop_sequence
)

select
    farm_fingerprint(concat(
        cast(service_date as string), '|', trip_id, '|', cast(stop_sequence as string)
    )) as stop_visit_key,
    service_date,
    trip_id,
    stop_sequence,
    stop_id,
    stop_role,
    route_id,
    direction_id,
    trip_headsign,
    vehicle_id,
    coalesce(trip_key, -1) as trip_key,
    coalesce(route_key, -1) as route_key,
    coalesce(stop_key, -1) as stop_key,
    arrival_ts_utc,
    arrival_earliest_ts,
    arrival_latest_ts,
    {{ as_mst('arrival_ts_utc') }} as arrival_ts_mst,
    {{ hour_mst('arrival_ts_utc') }} as arrival_hour_mst,
    departure_earliest_ts,
    departure_latest_ts,
    dwell_min_sec,
    dwell_max_sec,
    arrival_method,
    timestamp_diff(arrival_latest_ts, arrival_earliest_ts, second) as arrival_window_sec,
    timestamp_diff(arrival_latest_ts, arrival_earliest_ts, second) <= 30 as within_30s,
    scheduled_arrival_ts,
    scheduled_departure_ts,
    scheduled_headway_sec,
    -- NULL when either side is unknown; marts exclude unknown delays from on-time shares.
    timestamp_diff(arrival_ts_utc, scheduled_event_ts, second) as delay_sec,
    skipped,
    stopped_observed,
    before_report_ts,
    before_dist_along_m,
    after_report_ts,
    after_dist_along_m,
    stop_dist_m,
    nearest_offset_m,
    last_predicted_arrival_ts,
    last_prediction_published_ts,
    if(
        arrival_method like '%crossing%' or arrival_method = 'origin_departure',
        timestamp_diff(last_predicted_arrival_ts, arrival_ts_utc, second),
        null
    ) as prediction_error_sec,
    trip_switch_at_terminal,
    low_confidence,
    is_final,
    data_version,
    static_md5,
    _ingested_at
from conformed

model.whyline_denver_dbt.fct_micromobili.name: fct_micromobility_near_stop
model.whyline_denver_dbt.fct_micromobili.description: Veo scooters and bikes available within 200 m of each current stop inside Denver: per local date, stop, hour and form factor, the average over that hour's snapshots and the share of snapshots with none. Kept permanently; raw expires after 30 days.
model.whyline_denver_dbt.fct_micromobili.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized='incremental',
    incremental_strategy='insert_overwrite',
    partition_by={'field': 'date_mst', 'data_type': 'date'},
    cluster_by=['stop_id'],
    on_schema_change='append_new_columns',
    full_refresh=false
) }}

{#
Veo scooters and bikes available near each stop in Denver: per local date, stop, hour and form
factor, the average number of available vehicles within 200 m over that hour's snapshots, and
how often there were none. Stops outside the City and County of Denver (Veo's service area) are
left out. Raw snapshots expire after 30 days, so this is kept permanently and full refresh is
disabled. Each run replaces the last micromobility_days local dates and today so far: availability
is a snapshot count, so a past hour is final once its four snapshots exist; n_snapshots shows when
an hour is still filling.
#}
{% set days = var('micromobility_days', 2) %}
{% if is_incremental() %}
    {% set first = "date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval " ~ days ~ " day)" %}
{% else %}
    {% set first = "date '" ~ var('micromobility_start', '2026-11-02') ~ "'" %}
{% endif %}
{% set last = "current_date('America/Denver')" %}

with snapshots as (
    select distinct snapshot_ts_utc
    from {{ ref('stg_gbfs_veo_vehicles') }}
    where
        -- Constant bounds so BigQuery prunes the raw partitions; local days end after UTC midnight.
        snapshot_ts_utc >= timestamp({{ first }})
        and snapshot_ts_utc < timestamp(date_add({{ last }}, interval 2 day))
        and {{ date_mst('snapshot_ts_utc') }} between {{ first }} and {{ last }}
),
vehicles as (
    select v.snapshot_ts_utc, v.form_factor, v.geom
    from {{ ref('stg_gbfs_veo_vehicles') }} as v
    join snapshots as s
        on s.snapshot_ts_utc = v.snapshot_ts_utc
    where
        v.snapshot_ts_utc >= timestamp({{ first }})
        and v.snapshot_ts_utc < timestamp(date_add({{ last }}, interval 2 day))
        and v.is_available
        and v.form_factor in ('scooter', 'bicycle')
),
denver as (
    select st_union_agg(geom) as geom
    from {{ ref('dim_tract') }}
    where geom is not null
),
stops as (
    select s.stop_id, s.geom
    from {{ ref('dim_stop') }} as s
    cross join denver as d
    where s.is_current and st_contains(d.geom, s.geom)
),
counts as (
    select s.stop_id, v.snapshot_ts_utc, v.form_factor, count(*) as n_available
    from stops as s
    join vehicles as v
        on st_dwithin(s.geom, v.geom, 200)
    group by 1, 2, 3
),
grid as (
    -- Every stop, snapshot and form factor, so snapshots with none count as zero.
    select s.stop_id, n.snapshot_ts_utc, form_factor
    from stops as s
    cross join snapshots as n
    cross join unnest(['scooter', 'bicycle']) as form_factor
)

select
    {{ date_mst('g.snapshot_ts_utc') }} as date_mst,
    g.stop_id,
    {{ hour_mst('g.snapshot_ts_utc') }} as hour_mst,
    g.form_factor,
    count(*) as n_snapshots,
    round(avg(coalesce(c.n_available, 0)), 2) as avg_available_within_200m,
    avg(if(c.n_available is null, 1, 0)) as pct_snapshots_none_within_200m
from grid as g
left join counts as c
    on c.stop_id = g.stop_id
    and c.snapshot_ts_utc = g.snapshot_ts_utc
    and c.form_factor = g.form_factor
group by 1, 2, 3, 4

model.whyline_denver_dbt.bridge_segment_.name: bridge_segment_transit_lane
model.whyline_denver_dbt.bridge_segment_.description: Stop-to-stop segments that run along a Denver transit lane (at least half of the line between the stops within 15 m of the lane), with the lane's corridor, type and build year. One row per segment and lane.
model.whyline_denver_dbt.bridge_segment_.raw_code:
{#
Stop-to-stop segments that run along a Denver transit lane: at least half of the straight line
between the two stops lies within 15 m of the lane. One row per segment and lane (a street can
carry a business-access lane and a transit-only lane on the same blocks). Lane attributes are
from Denver's transit lanes layer; year_built is a year only.
#}
with lanes as (
    select
        trim(json_value(properties_json, '$.CORRIDOR')) as corridor,  -- one feature has a trailing space
        json_value(properties_json, '$.LANE_TYPE') as lane_type,
        safe_cast(json_value(properties_json, '$.YEAR_BUILT') as int64) as year_built,
        st_union_agg(geom) as geom
    from {{ ref('stg_arcgis_reference') }}
    where layer = 'denver_transit_lanes' and geom is not null
    group by 1, 2, 3
),
pairs as (
    select distinct from_stop_id, to_stop_id
    from {{ ref('fct_segment_traversal') }}
),
segments as (
    select
        p.from_stop_id,
        p.to_stop_id,
        st_makeline(a.geom, b.geom) as line
    from pairs as p
    join {{ ref('dim_stop') }} as a
        on a.stop_id = p.from_stop_id and a.is_current
    join {{ ref('dim_stop') }} as b
        on b.stop_id = p.to_stop_id and b.is_current
    where not st_equals(a.geom, b.geom)
),
overlap as (
    select
        s.from_stop_id,
        s.to_stop_id,
        l.corridor,
        l.lane_type,
        l.year_built,
        safe_divide(st_length(st_intersection(s.line, st_buffer(l.geom, 15))), st_length(s.line)) as share_on_lane
    from segments as s
    join lanes as l

{{ config(cluster_by=['trip_id']) }}

        ['route_id', 'service_id', 'direction_id', 'trip_headsign', 'shape_id'], 'trip_key') }}

union all

model.whyline_denver_dbt.dim_trip.compiled_code:
with versions as (
    
with versions_in as (
    select
        trip_id,
        _extract_date,
        route_id, service_id, direction_id, trip_headsign, shape_id,
        to_json_string(struct(route_id, service_id, direction_id, trip_headsign, shape_id)) as attr_sig
    from (select * from `whyline-denver`.`stg_denver`.`stg_gtfs_trips` where is_valid)
),
flagged as (
    select
        *,
        if(attr_sig = lag(attr_sig) over (partition by trip_id order by _extract_date), 0, 1) as is_change
    from versions_in
),
numbered as (
    select
        *,
        sum(is_change) over (
            partition by trip_id order by _extract_date rows unbounded preceding
        ) as version_num
    from flagged
),
grouped as (
    select
        trip_id,
        version_num,
        any_value(route_id) as route_id,
        any_value(service_id) as service_id,
        any_value(direction_id) as direction_id,
        any_value(trip_headsign) as trip_headsign,
        any_value(shape_id) as shape_id,
        min(_extract_date) as first_seen_extract,
        max(_extract_date) as last_seen_extract
    from numbered
    group by trip_id, version_num
),
bounded as (
    select
        *,
        if(version_num = 1, date '1900-01-01', first_seen_extract) as valid_from,
        lead(first_seen_extract) over (partition by trip_id order by version_num) as next_valid_from,
        max(last_seen_extract) over () as latest_extract
    from grouped
)
select
    farm_fingerprint(concat(cast(trip_id as string), '|', cast(valid_from as string))) as trip_key,
    trip_id,
    route_id, service_id, direction_id, trip_headsign, shape_id,
    valid_from,
    case
        when next_valid_from is not null then date_sub(next_valid_from, interval 1 day)
        when last_seen_extract = latest_extract then date '9999-12-31'
        else last_seen_extract
    end as valid_to,
    next_valid_from is null and last_seen_extract = latest_extract as is_current,
    next_valid_from is null as is_latest_version,
    first_seen_extract,
    last_seen_extract
from bounded

)

select
    trip_key,
    trip_id,
    route_id,
    service_id,
    direction_id,
    trip_headsign,
    shape_id,
    valid_from,
    valid_to,
    is_current,
    is_latest_version
from versions

    -1, cast(null as string), cast(null as string), cast(null as string), cast(null as int64),

model.whyline_denver_dbt.fct_stop_headwa.name: fct_stop_headway
model.whyline_denver_dbt.fct_stop_headwa.description: One row per stop visit a vehicle made (visits timed from the last prediction count only when the trip had a vehicle): observed headway since the previous vehicle of the same route and direction at the stop that service day, the arriving trip's scheduled headway, delay, day type and period. Rebuildable from fct_stop_visit.
model.whyline_denver_dbt.fct_stop_headwa.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized='incremental',
    incremental_strategy='insert_overwrite',
    partition_by={'field': 'service_date', 'data_type': 'date'},
    cluster_by=['route_id', 'stop_id'],
    on_schema_change='append_new_columns'
) }}

{#
Observed headways: for each stop visit a vehicle made, the time since the previous vehicle of
the same route and direction reached the stop that service day, next to the scheduled headway
of the arriving trip. Visits timed from the last prediction count only when the trip had a
vehicle, so a ghost trip leaves the gap riders saw; skipped stops have no arrival. Rebuildable
from fct_stop_visit; nightly runs replace the last wait_days service dates.
#}
{% set days = var('wait_days', 3) %}
{% if is_incremental() %}
    {% set first = "date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval " ~ days ~ " day)" %}
{% else %}
    {% set first = "date '" ~ var('wait_start', '2026-10-29') ~ "'" %}
{% endif %}
{% set last = "date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day)" %}

with visits as (
    select
        v.service_date,
        v.stop_id,
        v.route_id,
        v.direction_id,
        v.trip_id,
        v.stop_sequence,
        v.arrival_method,
        v.arrival_ts_utc,
        v.scheduled_headway_sec,
        v.delay_sec,
        lag(v.arrival_ts_utc) over (
            partition by v.service_date, v.route_id, v.direction_id, v.stop_id
            order by v.arrival_ts_utc, v.trip_id
        ) as previous_arrival_ts
    from {{ ref('fct_stop_visit') }} as v
    left join {{ ref('fct_trip_status') }} as t
        on t.service_date = v.service_date
        and t.trip_id = v.trip_id
        and t.service_date between {{ first }} and {{ last }}
    where
        v.service_date between {{ first }} and {{ last }}
        and v.arrival_ts_utc is not null
        and (
            v.arrival_method in ('shape_crossing', 'shape_crossing_gap', 'origin_departure')
            or (v.arrival_method = 'last_prediction' and coalesce(t.had_vehicle, false))
        )
)

select
    service_date,
    stop_id,
    route_id,
    direction_id,
    trip_id,
    stop_sequence,
    arrival_method,
    arrival_ts_utc,
    case format_date('%u', service_date)
        when '6' then 'saturday'
        when '7' then 'sunday'
        else 'weekday'
    end as day_type,
    case
        when {{ hour_mst('arrival_ts_utc') }} between 4 and 6 then 'early'
        when {{ hour_mst('arrival_ts_utc') }} between 7 and 8 then 'am_peak'
        when {{ hour_mst('arrival_ts_utc') }} between 9 and 14 then 'midday'
        when {{ hour_mst('arrival_ts_utc') }} between 15 and 17 then 'pm_peak'
        when {{ hour_mst('arrival_ts_utc') }} between 18 and 20 then 'evening'
        else 'night'
    end as period,
    timestamp_diff(arrival_ts_utc, previous_arrival_ts, second) as observed_headway_sec,
    scheduled_headway_sec,
    delay_sec
from visits
where route_id is not null

{{ config(materialized='table', cluster_by=['stop_id'], meta={"allow_in_app": false}) }}

{#
Stops named in RTD service alerts, current and past: one row per stop and alert, with when the
alert applied and whether it is in effect now. is_closure marks NO_SERVICE and STOP_MOVED alerts;
detours often close stops too but say so only in the text. History starts when snapshots began
(2026-11-02); earlier alerts are missing unless still in the feed then.
#}
with intervals as (
    {{ alert_intervals() }}
)

select
    i.stop_id,
    any_value(st.stop_name) as stop_name,
    any_value(st.lat) as lat,
    any_value(st.lon) as lon,
    i.alert_id,
    any_value(i.cause) as cause,
    any_value(i.effect) as effect,
    any_value(i.effect) in ('NO_SERVICE', 'STOP_MOVED') as is_closure,
    any_value(i.header_text) as header_text,
    string_agg(distinct i.route_id, ',' order by i.route_id) as route_ids,
    min(i.start_ts) as from_ts,
    if(countif(i.end_ts is null) > 0, null, max(i.end_ts)) as until_ts,
    logical_and(not i.has_ended)
    and min(i.start_ts) <= current_timestamp()
    and (countif(i.end_ts is null) > 0 or max(i.end_ts) > current_timestamp()) as is_active_now,
    current_timestamp() as build_run_at
from intervals as i
left join {{ ref('dim_stop') }} as st
    on st.stop_id = i.stop_id
    and st.is_current
where i.stop_id is not null
group by i.stop_id, i.alert_id

model.whyline_denver_dbt.mart_alerts_by_.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='table', cluster_by=['route_id'], meta={"allow_in_app": false}) }}

{#
How much of each day each route was under a service alert, by effect: alerts in effect, alert
hours (each alert's overlap with the local day, so two alerts at once count twice), and stops
named. Days run from alerts_start (when snapshots began) to today. Published with release R2.
#}
with intervals as (
    select distinct
        alert_id,
        route_id,
        coalesce(effect, 'UNKNOWN_EFFECT') as effect,
        stop_id,
        start_ts,
        coalesce(end_ts, current_timestamp()) as end_ts
    from ({{ alert_intervals() }})
    where route_id is not null
),
days as (
    select
        d as service_date_mst,
        timestamp(d, 'America/Denver') as day_start,
        timestamp(date_add(d, interval 1 day), 'America/Denver') as day_end
    from unnest(generate_date_array(date '{{ var("alerts_start", "2026-11-02") }}', current_date('America/Denver'))) as d
),
by_day as (
    select i.*, d.service_date_mst, d.day_start, d.day_end
    from intervals as i
    join days as d
        on i.start_ts < d.day_end
        and i.end_ts > d.day_start
),
alert_hours as (
    -- Each period once per alert and route, whatever the number of stops it names.
    select
        route_id,
        service_date_mst,
        effect,
        alert_id,
        sum(timestamp_diff(least(end_ts, day_end), greatest(start_ts, day_start), second)) / 3600 as hours
    from (select distinct route_id, service_date_mst, effect, alert_id, start_ts, end_ts, day_start, day_end from by_day)
    group by 1, 2, 3, 4
),
stops as (
    select route_id, service_date_mst, effect, count(distinct stop_id) as n_stops_named
    from by_day
    group by 1, 2, 3
)

    select distinct
        alert_id,
        route_id,
        coalesce(effect, 'UNKNOWN_EFFECT') as effect,

    from (

    select
        p.alert_id,
        p.route_id,
        p.direction_id,
        p.stop_id,
        p.trip_id,
        a.cause,

mode.name: mode
mode.description: NTD mode code: MB bus, LR light rail, CR commuter rail, DR demand response, VP vanpool.

boardings.name: boardings
boardings.description: Unlinked passenger trips: every boarding counts, so a ride with one transfer counts twice.

revenue_hours.description: Vehicle revenue hours, directly operated and purchased service combined.

{{ config(materialized='table', meta={"allow_in_app": false}) }}

{#
RTD ridership and service by mode and month from the National Transit Database: boardings
(unlinked trips, so a transfer counts twice), revenue hours and miles, boardings per revenue
hour, and the change from the same month a year earlier. NTD runs about two months behind.
#}
with by_mode as (
    select
        month,
        mode,
        any_value(mode_group) as mode_group,
        sum(upt) as boardings,
        sum(vrh) as revenue_hours,
        sum(vrm) as revenue_miles,
        sum(voms) as peak_vehicles
    from {{ ref('fct_ntd_service_month') }}
    group by 1, 2
)

select
    b.month,
    b.mode,
    case b.mode
        when 'MB' then 'Bus'
        when 'LR' then 'Light rail'
        when 'CR' then 'Commuter rail'
        when 'DR' then 'Demand response'
        when 'VP' then 'Vanpool'
        else b.mode
    end as mode_name,
    b.mode_group,
    b.boardings,
    b.revenue_hours,
    b.revenue_miles,
    b.peak_vehicles,
    round(safe_divide(b.boardings, b.revenue_hours), 2) as boardings_per_revenue_hour,
    prior.boardings as boardings_year_earlier,
    round(safe_divide(b.boardings, prior.boardings) - 1, 4) as boardings_yoy_change,
    current_timestamp() as build_run_at
from by_mode as b
-- A join, not lag(12), so a missing month can't shift the comparison.
left join by_mode as prior
    on prior.mode = b.mode
    and prior.month = date_sub(b.month, interval 12 month)

model.whyline_denver_dbt.mart_job_access.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='table', meta={"allow_in_app": false}) }}

{#
How many jobs can I reach by transit? Per census tract in the RTD counties and departure
window: jobs reachable within 30, 45 and 60 minutes by walking and transit, as counts and as a
share of the region's jobs. Travel times come from the published schedule, not from what ran;
jobs are LEHD LODES workplace counts. Denver tracts also carry their EnviroScreen percentile.
Published with release R3.
#}
with access as (
    select
        geoid,
        departure_window,
        any_value(departure_date) as departure_date,
        max(if(minutes_threshold = 30, jobs_reachable, null)) as jobs_within_30min,
        max(if(minutes_threshold = 45, jobs_reachable, null)) as jobs_within_45min,
        max(if(minutes_threshold = 60, jobs_reachable, null)) as jobs_within_60min,
        any_value(total_jobs_region) as total_jobs_region,
        any_value(lodes_year) as lodes_year
    from {{ ref('fct_job_access') }}
    group by 1, 2
),
enviroscreen as (
    select
        json_value(properties_json, '$.GEOID') as geoid,
        safe_cast(json_value(properties_json, '$.ES_S_') as float64) as enviroscreen_pctl
    from {{ ref('stg_arcgis_reference') }}
    where layer = 'enviroscreen_tract'
)

select
    a.geoid,
    substr(a.geoid, 3, 3) = '031' as is_denver,
    a.departure_window,
    a.departure_date,
    a.jobs_within_30min,
    a.jobs_within_45min,
    a.jobs_within_60min,
    round(safe_divide(a.jobs_within_45min, a.total_jobs_region), 4) as pct_region_jobs_45min,
    a.total_jobs_region,
    a.lodes_year,
    e.enviroscreen_pctl,
    current_timestamp() as build_run_at
from access as a
left join enviroscreen as e
    using (geoid)

model.whyline_denver_dbt.mart_micromobil.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='table', cluster_by=['stop_id'], meta={"allow_in_app": false}) }}

{#
First and last mile: how many Veo scooters and bikes are usually available within 200 m of each
Denver stop, and how often there are none, by weekday or weekend and period, over the last
micromobility_window_days local dates, today included. Stops beside a Veo staging site (W 10th Ave & Decatur St)
show inflated counts; they're kept, with the caveat in the glossary. Goes into the app with the next release.
#}
{% set window_days = var('micromobility_window_days', 28) %}

with hours as (
    select
        *,
        if(format_date('%u', date_mst) in ('6', '7'), 'weekend', 'weekday') as day_type,
        case
            when hour_mst between 4 and 6 then 'early'
            when hour_mst between 7 and 8 then 'am_peak'
            when hour_mst between 9 and 14 then 'midday'
            when hour_mst between 15 and 17 then 'pm_peak'
            when hour_mst between 18 and 20 then 'evening'
            else 'night'
        end as period
    from {{ ref('fct_micromobility_near_stop') }}
    where date_mst between date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval {{ window_days - 1 }} day)
        and current_date('America/Denver')
)

select
    h.stop_id,
    any_value(st.stop_name) as stop_name,
    any_value(st.lat) as lat,
    any_value(st.lon) as lon,
    h.day_type,
    h.period,
    count(distinct h.date_mst) as n_days,
    round(safe_divide(sum(if(h.form_factor = 'scooter', h.avg_available_within_200m * h.n_snapshots, 0)),
        sum(if(h.form_factor = 'scooter', h.n_snapshots, 0))), 2) as avg_scooters_within_200m,
    round(safe_divide(sum(if(h.form_factor = 'bicycle', h.avg_available_within_200m * h.n_snapshots, 0)),
        sum(if(h.form_factor = 'bicycle', h.n_snapshots, 0))), 2) as avg_bikes_within_200m,
    safe_divide(sum(if(h.form_factor = 'scooter', h.pct_snapshots_none_within_200m * h.n_snapshots, 0)),
        sum(if(h.form_factor = 'scooter', h.n_snapshots, 0))) as pct_time_no_scooter,
    safe_divide(sum(if(h.form_factor = 'bicycle', h.pct_snapshots_none_within_200m * h.n_snapshots, 0)),
        sum(if(h.form_factor = 'bicycle', h.n_snapshots, 0))) as pct_time_no_bike,
    current_timestamp() as build_run_at
from hours as h
left join {{ ref('dim_stop') }} as st
    on st.stop_id = h.stop_id
    and st.is_current
group by h.stop_id, h.day_type, h.period

stop_id.description: GTFS stop identifier; joins to mart_gtfs_stops.stop_id.

sidewalk_len_m_within_200m.description: Total length (meters) of sidewalks intersecting the 200 m stop buffer.

access_score_0_100.description: Min–max normalized sidewalk length score for the stop (0 = least, 100 = most sidewalk coverage).

crosswalk_len_m_within_200m.description: Of sidewalk_len_m_within_200m, the length Denver inventories as crosswalk: a rough measure of marked crossings near the stop.

wheelchair_boarding.description: GTFS wheelchair_boarding for the stop: 1 accessible, 2 not accessible, 0 no information.

stop_name.description: Stop name from the latest GTFS version of this stop.

lat.description: Stop latitude (WGS84) from the latest GTFS version of this stop.

model.whyline_denver_dbt.mart_access_sco.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='table', meta={"allow_in_app": true}) }}

with current_stops as (
    select stop_id, stop_name, lat, lon, geom, wheelchair_boarding
    from {{ ref('dim_stop') }}
    where is_current
),
buffers as (
    select
        stop_id,
        st_buffer(geom, 200) as buf
    from current_stops
),
sidewalk_len as (
    select
        b.stop_id,
        sum(st_length(st_intersection(sw.geom, b.buf))) as tot_len_m,
        sum(if(sw.class = 'crosswalk', st_length(st_intersection(sw.geom, b.buf)), 0)) as crosswalk_len_m
    from buffers as b
    join {{ ref('dim_sidewalk_segment') }} as sw
        on st_intersects(sw.geom, b.buf)
    where sw.sidewalk_key != -1
    group by
        b.stop_id
),
stops as (
    select
        b.stop_id,
        200 as buffer_m,
        coalesce(s.tot_len_m, 0) as sidewalk_len_m_within_200m,
        coalesce(s.crosswalk_len_m, 0) as crosswalk_len_m_within_200m
    from buffers as b
    left join sidewalk_len as s
        using (stop_id)
)

select
    stop_id,
    buffer_m,
    sidewalk_len_m_within_200m,
    cast(
        round(
            case
                when max(sidewalk_len_m_within_200m) over () = min(sidewalk_len_m_within_200m) over ()
                    then 100
                else (
                    (sidewalk_len_m_within_200m - min(sidewalk_len_m_within_200m) over ()) /
                    nullif(
                        max(sidewalk_len_m_within_200m) over () - min(sidewalk_len_m_within_200m) over (),
                        0
                    ) * 100
                )
            end,
            1
        ) as float64
    ) as access_score_0_100,
    current_timestamp() as build_run_at,
    cs.stop_name,
    cs.lat,
    cs.lon,
    crosswalk_len_m_within_200m,
    cs.wheelchair_boarding
from stops
left join current_stops as cs
    using (stop_id)

with params as (

        365 as window_days
    from {{ ref('fct_crash') }}
),
st as (

        lat,
        lon,
        geom
    from {{ ref('dim_stop') }}
    where is_current
),
cr as (
    select
        event_ts_utc,
        geom,
        severity,
        ped_involved = 1 as ped_involved,
        bike_involved = 1 as bike_involved
    from {{ ref('fct_crash') }}
    cross join params
    where date(event_ts_utc) between date_sub(params.as_of_date, interval params.window_days day) and params.as_of_date
),
stop_crash as (
    select
        s.stop_id,
        params.as_of_date,
        params.window_days,
        cr.severity,
        cr.ped_involved,
        cr.bike_involved,
        st_distance(s.geom, cr.geom) as distance_m
    from params
    cross join st as s

        on st_dwithin(s.geom, cr.geom, 250)
),
agg as (
    select
        stop_id,
        as_of_date,
        window_days,
        countif(distance_m <= 100) as crash_100m_cnt,
        countif(distance_m <= 100 and severity >= 3) as severe_100m_cnt,

        window_days
)

{#
Is it safe and accessible to walk to this stop? For each stop inside Denver, the street around
it (bridge_stop_street_safety) and plain-language flags: on the High Injury Network with no
traffic signal within 100 m, no curb ramp within 50 m. Pedestrian crash counts are in

select
    b.stop_id,
    st.stop_name,
    st.lat,
    st.lon,
    b.on_hin,
    b.hin_tier,
    b.nearest_signal_m,
    b.n_curb_ramps_50m,
    b.existing_bikeway_within_100m,
    b.on_transit_lane,
    b.transit_signal_priority_within_50m,
    b.queue_jump_within_50m,
    array_to_string(
        array(
            select flag from unnest([
                if(b.on_hin and coalesce(b.nearest_signal_m, 1000) > 100, 'on the High Injury Network, no signal within 100 m', null),
                if(b.on_hin and b.hin_tier = 1, 'on a tier 1 High Injury Network street', null),

            ]) as flag
            where flag is not null

        '; '
    ) as walk_safety_flags,
    current_timestamp() as build_run_at
from {{ ref('bridge_stop_street_safety') }} as b
left join {{ ref('dim_stop') }} as st
    on st.stop_id = b.stop_id
    and st.is_current

{{ config(

    cluster_by=['stop_id'],
    meta={"allow_in_app": true}
) }}

{#
Load points: how often vehicles arrived at each stop with few seats or standing room only, by
route, direction, weekday or weekend and hour, over the last crowding_window_days complete
service dates. Levels are the highest reported on the way to or at the stop. Shares count only
visits with occupancy data. Published after the coverage check; until then allow_in_app is false.
#}
{% set window_days = var('crowding_window_days', 28) %}

with visits as (
    select
        stop_id,
        route_id,
        direction_id,
        if(format_date('%u', service_date) in ('6', '7'), 'weekend', 'weekday') as day_type,
        {{ hour_mst('event_ts_utc') }} as hour_mst,
        service_date,
        max_level
    from {{ ref('fct_trip_occupancy') }}
    where
        service_date between date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval {{ window_days }} day)
        and date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day)
        and route_id is not null
        and event_ts_utc is not null
)

select
    v.stop_id,
    st.stop_name,
    st.lat,
    st.lon,
    v.route_id,
    v.direction_id,
    v.day_type,
    v.hour_mst,
    count(*) as n_visits,
    countif(v.max_level is not null) as n_visits_with_data,
    countif(v.max_level is not null) / count(*) as pct_visits_with_data,
    avg(if(v.max_level is null, null, if(v.max_level >= 2, 1, 0))) as pct_few_seats_or_worse,
    avg(if(v.max_level is null, null, if(v.max_level >= 3, 1, 0))) as pct_standing_or_worse,
    min(v.service_date) as first_service_date,
    max(v.service_date) as last_service_date,
    current_timestamp() as build_run_at
from visits as v
left join {{ ref('dim_stop') }} as st
    on st.stop_id = v.stop_id
    and st.is_current
group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8

{{ config(
    materialized='incremental',
    incremental_strategy='insert_overwrite',
    partition_by={'field': 'service_date_mst', 'data_type': 'date'},
    cluster_by=['route_id'],

{#
How far arrival predictions were off, per route, day and how far ahead they were shown.
error_sec = actual - predicted (positive: the vehicle came later than predicted). Published in
the app after the stop-visit dual-run review; until then allow_in_app is false.
#}
{% set days = var('prediction_accuracy_days', 3) %}

select
    route_id,
    service_date as service_date_mst,
    horizon_bucket,
    count(*) as n_visits,
    countif(has_prediction) as n_predictions,
    countif(not has_prediction) as n_no_prediction,
    avg(if(has_prediction, if(within_band, 1, 0), null)) as pct_within_band,
    approx_quantiles(error_sec, 100)[offset(50)] as median_error_sec,
    approx_quantiles(error_sec, 100)[offset(5)] as p05_error_sec,
    approx_quantiles(error_sec, 100)[offset(95)] as p95_error_sec,
    -- Extra minutes a rider must allow to avoid missing a vehicle that comes early.
    greatest(0, -approx_quantiles(error_sec, 100)[offset(5)]) as padding_sec,
    avg(if(has_prediction, if(error_sec > 120, 1, 0), null)) as pct_later_by_2min,
    avg(if(has_prediction, if(error_sec < -60, 1, 0), null)) as pct_earlier_by_1min,
    current_timestamp() as build_run_at
from {{ ref('fct_prediction_accuracy') }}
where route_id is not null
{% if is_incremental() %}
    and service_date >= date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval {{ days }} day)
{% endif %}
group by 1, 2, 3

        max(sched_arrival_ts_mst) as end_ts
    from {{ ref('fct_scheduled_stop_time') }}
    where service_date_mst between {{ first }} and {{ last }}
    group by 1, 2
),
trips as (
    select
        s.*,
        case
            when t.outcome is null then 'not_tracked'
            when t.outcome = 'canceled' then 'canceled'
            -- Visits inferred from predictions alone don't show a vehicle ran.
            when not t.had_vehicle then 'no_vehicle'
            when t.outcome in ('completed', 'partial') then 'delivered'
            else 'vehicle_no_visits'
        end as delivery,
        case
            when {{ hour_mst('s.start_ts') }} between 4 and 6 then 'early'
            when {{ hour_mst('s.start_ts') }} between 7 and 8 then 'am_peak'
            when {{ hour_mst('s.start_ts') }} between 9 and 14 then 'midday'
            when {{ hour_mst('s.start_ts') }} between 15 and 17 then 'pm_peak'
            when {{ hour_mst('s.start_ts') }} between 18 and 20 then 'evening'
            else 'night'

        and t.trip_id = s.trip_id
        and t.service_date between {{ first }} and {{ last }}
),
vehicle_reporting as (
    select
        route_id,
        avg(if(had_vehicle, 1, 0)) as pct_tracked_with_vehicle
    from {{ ref('fct_trip_status') }}
    where
        service_date between date_sub({{ last }}, interval 27 day) and {{ last }}
        and outcome not in ('canceled', 'no_static')
    group by 1
),
observable as (
    select
        t.service_date,
        t.trip_id,
        logical_and(coalesce(h.is_healthy, false)) as is_observable
    from trips as t
    left join {{ ref('fct_stream_health') }} as h
        on h.window_start_utc > timestamp_sub(t.start_ts, interval 25 minute)
        and h.window_start_utc <= t.end_ts
        and h.window_date_utc between date_sub({{ first }}, interval 1 day)
        and date_add({{ last }}, interval 2 day)
    group by 1, 2
)

select
    t.route_id,
    t.direction_id,
    t.service_date as service_date_mst,
    t.period,

    countif(t.delivery = 'delivered') as n_delivered,
    countif(t.delivery = 'canceled') as n_canceled,
    countif(t.delivery = 'no_vehicle') as n_no_vehicle,

        safe_divide(countif(o.is_observable and t.delivery = 'delivered'), countif(o.is_observable)),

        safe_divide(
            countif(o.is_observable and t.delivery in ('canceled', 'no_vehicle', 'not_tracked')),

        null
    ) as pct_missed_likely,
    current_timestamp() as build_run_at
from trips as t
join observable as o
    on o.service_date = t.service_date
    and o.trip_id = t.trip_id
left join vehicle_reporting as v
    on v.route_id = t.route_id
where t.route_id is not null
