{#
How long trips really take, end to end, per route, direction, pattern (first and last stop)
and service date: from leaving the first stop to reaching the last, both timed to within 30 s.
buffer_time_index = (p90 - p50) / p50 is the extra share of time to allow to be on time 9 times
in 10; it includes the difference between peak and off-peak trips. Published after the
stop-visit review.
#}
{% set days = var('segment_days', 3) %}
{% if is_incremental() %}
    {% set first = "date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval " ~ days ~ " day)" %}
{% else %}
    {% set first = "date '" ~ var('segment_start', '2026-10-29') ~ "'" %}
{% endif %}
{% set last = "date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day)" %}

with trips as (
    select
        service_date,
        trip_id,
        any_value(route_id) as route_id,
        any_value(direction_id) as direction_id,
        max(if(stop_role = 'first', stop_id, null)) as first_stop_id,
        max(if(stop_role = 'last', stop_id, null)) as last_stop_id,
        max(if(stop_role = 'first' and arrival_method = 'origin_departure' and within_30s, arrival_ts_utc, null))
            as start_ts,
        max(if(stop_role = 'last' and within_30s, arrival_ts_utc, null)) as end_ts,
        max(if(stop_role = 'first', coalesce(scheduled_departure_ts, scheduled_arrival_ts), null))
            as scheduled_start_ts,
        max(if(stop_role = 'last', coalesce(scheduled_arrival_ts, scheduled_departure_ts), null))
            as scheduled_end_ts
    from {{ ref('fct_stop_visit') }}
    where service_date between {{ first }} and {{ last }}
    group by 1, 2
),
runtimes as (
    select
        *,
        timestamp_diff(end_ts, start_ts, second) as runtime_sec,
        timestamp_diff(scheduled_end_ts, scheduled_start_ts, second) as scheduled_runtime_sec
    from trips
    where route_id is not null and end_ts > start_ts
),
grouped as (
    select
        route_id,
        direction_id,
        first_stop_id,
        last_stop_id,
        service_date,
        count(*) as n_trips,
        approx_quantiles(runtime_sec, 100)[offset(50)] as p50_runtime_sec,
        approx_quantiles(runtime_sec, 100)[offset(90)] as p90_runtime_sec,
        approx_quantiles(scheduled_runtime_sec, 100)[offset(50)] as scheduled_runtime_sec
    from runtimes
    group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
)

select
    g.route_id,

    b.stop_name as last_stop_name,

    round(g.scheduled_runtime_sec / 60, 1) as scheduled_runtime_min,

from grouped as g

{#
Wait time, bunching and gaps per route and service date, over every stop. Excess wait uses only
headways scheduled every 15 minutes or better, where riders don't time their arrival; on-time
share and late running cover every visit. Published after the stop-visit review.
#}
{% set days = var('wait_days', 3) %}

with headways as (
    -- h and s: frequent observed and scheduled headways, kept only where both are known.
    select
        *,
        if(scheduled_headway_sec between 1 and 900, observed_headway_sec, null) as h,
        if(observed_headway_sec is not null and scheduled_headway_sec between 1 and 900, scheduled_headway_sec, null) as s
    from {{ ref('fct_stop_headway') }}
    {% if is_incremental() %}
    where service_date >= date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval {{ days }} day)
    {% endif %}
)

select
    route_id,
    service_date as service_date_mst,
    count(*) as n_visits,
    count(h) as n_frequent_headways,
    safe_divide(sum(h * h), 2 * sum(h)) as expected_wait_sec,
    safe_divide(sum(s * s), 2 * sum(s)) as scheduled_wait_sec,
    safe_divide(sum(h * h), 2 * sum(h)) - safe_divide(sum(s * s), 2 * sum(s)) as excess_wait_sec,
    avg(if(h is null, null, if(h < 0.25 * s, 1, 0))) as pct_bunched,
    avg(if(h is null, null, if(h > 1.5 * s, 1, 0))) as pct_gap,
    avg(if(
        delay_sec is null, null,
        if(delay_sec > -{{ var('on_time_early_sec', 60) }} and delay_sec <= {{ var('on_time_late_sec', 300) }}, 1, 0)
    )) as pct_on_time,
    approx_quantiles(delay_sec, 10)[offset(9)] as p90_delay_sec,
    current_timestamp() as build_run_at
from headways
group by 1, 2

    cluster_by=['stop_id'],
    meta={"allow_in_app": true}
) }}

{#
How long riders actually wait at each stop, by route, direction, day type and period, over the
last wait_window_days complete service dates. With riders arriving at random, the average wait
is E[H^2] / 2E[H] over the headways H between vehicles; excess wait is that minus the same over
the scheduled headways. Frequent groups (scheduled every 15 minutes or better on average) are
read by excess wait; infrequent ones by on-time share, since riders time their arrival.
Published after the stop-visit review.
#}
{% set window_days = var('wait_window_days', 28) %}

with headways as (
    -- h and s: observed and scheduled headways, kept only where both are known.
    select
        *,
        if(scheduled_headway_sec > 0, observed_headway_sec, null) as h,
        if(observed_headway_sec is not null and scheduled_headway_sec > 0, scheduled_headway_sec, null) as s
    from {{ ref('fct_stop_headway') }}
    where service_date between date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval {{ window_days }} day)
        and date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day)
),
grouped as (
    select
        stop_id,
        route_id,
        direction_id,
        day_type,
        period,
        count(distinct service_date) as n_days,
        count(*) as n_visits,
        count(h) as n_headways,

{{ config(
    materialized='incremental',
    incremental_strategy='insert_overwrite',
    partition_by={'field': 'service_date_mst', 'data_type': 'date'},
    cluster_by=['route_id'],

{#
How crowded each route's trips were, by direction, service date and the hour the trip left its
first stop. A trip's level is the highest occupancy reported anywhere on it; shares count only
trips with occupancy data, and pct_trips_with_data says how many that is. Published after the
coverage check; until then allow_in_app is false.
#}
{% set days = var('crowding_days', 3) %}

with stops as (
    select *
    from {{ ref('fct_trip_occupancy') }}
    where route_id is not null
    {% if is_incremental() %}
        and service_date >= date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval {{ days }} day)
    {% endif %}
),
peaks as (
    -- Where each trip's highest level was first reported.
    select service_date, trip_id, stop_id as peak_stop_id
    from stops
    where max_level is not null
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by service_date, trip_id order by max_level desc, stop_sequence
    ) = 1
),
trips as (
    select
        s.service_date,
        s.trip_id,
        any_value(s.route_id) as route_id,
        any_value(s.direction_id) as direction_id,
        {{ hour_mst('min(s.event_ts_utc)') }} as departure_hour_mst,
        max(s.max_level) as trip_level,
        any_value(p.peak_stop_id) as peak_stop_id
    from stops as s
    left join peaks as p
        on p.service_date = s.service_date
        and p.trip_id = s.trip_id
    group by 1, 2
),
peak_mode as (
    -- The stop where crowded trips (few seats or worse) most often peaked.
    select route_id, direction_id, service_date, departure_hour_mst, peak_stop_id
    from trips
    where trip_level >= 2
    group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by route_id, direction_id, service_date, departure_hour_mst
        order by count(*) desc, peak_stop_id
    ) = 1
)

select
    t.route_id,
    t.direction_id,
    t.service_date as service_date_mst,
    t.departure_hour_mst,
    count(*) as n_trips,
    countif(t.trip_level is not null) as n_trips_with_data,
    countif(t.trip_level is not null) / count(*) as pct_trips_with_data,
    avg(if(t.trip_level is null, null, if(t.trip_level >= 2, 1, 0))) as pct_trips_few_seats_or_worse,
    avg(if(t.trip_level is null, null, if(t.trip_level >= 3, 1, 0))) as pct_trips_standing_or_worse,
    any_value(m.peak_stop_id) as peak_stop_id_mode,
    current_timestamp() as build_run_at
from trips as t
left join peak_mode as m
    on m.route_id = t.route_id
    and m.direction_id = t.direction_id
    and m.service_date = t.service_date
    and m.departure_hour_mst = t.departure_hour_mst
group by 1, 2, 3, 4

{#
Where buses and trains crawl: speed and running time between consecutive stops, by route,
direction, day type and hour of departure, over the last segment_window_days complete service
dates. lat and lon are the midpoint between the two stops, so the app maps segments as points.
Published after the stop-visit review.
#}
{% set window_days = var('segment_window_days', 28) %}

with grouped as (
    select
        from_stop_id,
        to_stop_id,
        route_id,
        direction_id,
        day_type,
        depart_hour_mst as hour_mst,
        count(*) as n_traversals,
        count(distinct service_date) as n_days,
        approx_quantiles(distance_m, 100)[offset(50)] as distance_m,
        approx_quantiles(speed_kmh, 100)[offset(50)] as p50_speed_kmh,
        approx_quantiles(speed_kmh, 100)[offset(10)] as p10_speed_kmh,
        approx_quantiles(travel_sec, 100)[offset(50)] as p50_travel_sec,
        approx_quantiles(travel_sec, 100)[offset(90)] as p90_travel_sec,
        approx_quantiles(scheduled_travel_sec, 100)[offset(50)] as scheduled_travel_sec
    from {{ ref('fct_segment_traversal') }}
    where service_date between date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval {{ window_days }} day)
        and date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day)
    group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
)

select
    g.from_stop_id,
    a.stop_name as from_stop_name,
    g.to_stop_id,
    b.stop_name as to_stop_name,
    (a.lat + b.lat) / 2 as lat,
    (a.lon + b.lon) / 2 as lon,
    g.route_id,
    g.direction_id,
    g.day_type,
    g.hour_mst,
    g.n_traversals,
    g.n_days,
    g.distance_m,
    g.p50_speed_kmh,
    g.p10_speed_kmh,
    g.p50_travel_sec,
    g.p90_travel_sec,
    g.scheduled_travel_sec,
    -- NULL where the schedule gives both stops the same minute.
    safe_divide(g.p50_travel_sec, nullif(g.scheduled_travel_sec, 0)) as delay_ratio,
    current_timestamp() as build_run_at
from grouped as g
left join {{ ref('dim_stop') }} as a
    on a.stop_id = g.from_stop_id
    and a.is_current
left join {{ ref('dim_stop') }} as b
    on b.stop_id = g.to_stop_id
    and b.is_current

model.whyline_denver_dbt.mart_reliabilit.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized='incremental',
    incremental_strategy='insert_overwrite',
    unique_key=['route_id', 'service_date_mst', 'precip_bin', 'snow_day'],
    partition_by={"field": "service_date_mst", "data_type": "date"},
    cluster_by=["route_id"],
    on_schema_change='append_new_columns',
    full_refresh=false,
    meta={"allow_in_app": true}
) }}

{#
Observed stop visits (core.fct_stop_visit) per route and service date. On time follows RTD:
less than one minute early and no more than five minutes late; visits with an unknown delay are
excluded from the on-time share and the delay statistics instead of counting as on time.
pct_observed is the share of the day's scheduled stop events that have an observed visit:
canceled and unseen trips count against it, trips not in the schedule don't count, and the
current day's value rises as the day goes on. Backfilled (15-minute sample) visits stay out
until their calibration is published (publish_backfill). Partitions built before the cutover
keep the legacy sampled method; their data_version is NULL. Realtime runs pass
route_day_window_days=1 (yesterday and today, the dates fct_stop_visit still changes); nightly
runs rebuild 30 days so late weather lands. Full refreshes are disabled because pre-cutover
partitions can no longer be rebuilt; rebuild a longer span with a wider route_day_window_days.
#}
{% set window_days = var('route_day_window_days', var('weather_lookback_days', 30)) %}
{% set versions = "'stream_v1', 'backfill_v1'" if var('publish_backfill', false) else "'stream_v1'" %}

with e as (
    select
        route_id,
        service_date as service_date_mst,
        delay_sec,
        arrival_method,
        arrival_window_sec,
        within_30s,
        skipped,
        data_version
    from {{ ref('fct_stop_visit') }}
    -- Unassigned visits remain in the fact (route_key -1) but cannot contribute to route metrics.
    where route_id is not null
      and data_version in ({{ versions }})
    {%- if not var('publish_backfill', false) %}
      -- The poller started early on 2026-10-29, so the service date before holds only a few late
      -- trips; rebuilding that date would replace its full legacy partition with them.
      and service_date >= '{{ var("stream_first_full_date", "2026-10-29") }}'
    {%- endif %}
    {% if is_incremental() %}
        and service_date >= date_sub(current_date("America/Denver"), interval {{ window_days }} day)
    {% endif %}
),
w as (
    select
        weather_date as service_date_mst,
        precip_bin,
        snow_day,
        precip_mm,
        snow_mm,
        tmin_c,
        tmax_c
    from {{ ref('fct_weather_daily') }}
    where station = '{{ var("weather_station", "USW00003017") }}'
),
canceled as (
    select
        route_id,
        service_date as service_date_mst,
        countif(outcome = 'canceled') as n_canceled_trips
    from {{ ref('fct_trip_status') }}
    where route_id is not null
      and data_version in ({{ versions }})
    {% if is_incremental() %}
        and service_date >= date_sub(current_date("America/Denver"), interval {{ window_days }} day)
    {% endif %}
    group by route_id, service_date_mst
),
scheduled as (
    -- The schedule fact runs 30 days ahead, so the upper bound keeps the scan to the window.
    select
        route_id,
        service_date_mst,
        count(*) as n_scheduled
    from {{ ref('fct_scheduled_stop_time') }}
    where service_date_mst <= current_date("America/Denver")
    {% if is_incremental() %}
        and service_date_mst >= date_sub(current_date("America/Denver"), interval {{ window_days }} day)
    {% endif %}
    group by route_id, service_date_mst
),
agg as (
    select
        e.route_id,

with base as (
    select
        route_id,

    -- Stop-visit days only: legacy on-time runs about 14 points higher, so a window that spans the

model.whyline_denver_dbt.mart_reliabilit.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized='incremental',
    incremental_strategy='insert_overwrite',
    unique_key=['stop_id', 'service_date_mst', 'event_hour_mst'],
    partition_by={"field": "service_date_mst", "data_type": "date"},
    cluster_by=["stop_id"],
    on_schema_change='append_new_columns',
    full_refresh=false,
    meta={"allow_in_app": true}
) }}

{#
Observed stop visits per stop, service date and arrival hour (Denver). On time and unknown
delays as in mart_reliability_by_route_day. Observed headway: time since the previous visit at
the same stop by the same route and direction; it is adherent when within headway_tol_ratio of
that visit's scheduled headway (the gap to the previous scheduled trip), so a missed trip shows
as a long observed headway. Backfilled visits stay out until published (publish_backfill).
Each run replaces whole service-date partitions, so a rebuilt date keeps no legacy rows. Full
refreshes are disabled because pre-cutover partitions can no longer be rebuilt (their legacy
models are disabled); rebuild a longer span with a wider stop_hour_window_days.
#}
{% set window_days = var('stop_hour_window_days', 1) %}
{% set versions = "'stream_v1', 'backfill_v1'" if var('publish_backfill', false) else "'stream_v1'" %}

with base as (
    select
        stop_id,
        route_id,
        direction_id,
        service_date as service_date_mst,
        arrival_hour_mst as event_hour_mst,
        arrival_ts_utc,
        delay_sec,
        scheduled_headway_sec,
        arrival_method,
        within_30s,
        data_version
    from {{ ref('fct_stop_visit') }}
    where stop_id is not null
      and arrival_ts_utc is not null
      and data_version in ({{ versions }})
    {%- if not var('publish_backfill', false) %}
      -- The poller started early on 2026-10-29, so the service date before holds only a few late
      -- trips; rebuilding that date would replace its full legacy partition with them.
      and service_date >= '{{ var("stream_first_full_date", "2026-10-29") }}'
    {%- endif %}
    {% if is_incremental() %}
        and service_date >= date_sub(current_date("America/Denver"), interval {{ window_days }} day)
    {% endif %}
),
headways as (
    select
        *,
        timestamp_diff(
            arrival_ts_utc,
            lag(arrival_ts_utc) over (
                partition by stop_id, route_id, direction_id, service_date_mst
                order by arrival_ts_utc
            ),
            second
        ) as obs_headway_sec
    from base
),
head as (
    select
        stop_id,
        service_date_mst,
        event_hour_mst,
        avg(
            case
                when obs_headway_sec is null
                    or scheduled_headway_sec is null
                    or scheduled_headway_sec <= 0 then null
                when abs(obs_headway_sec - scheduled_headway_sec) / scheduled_headway_sec
                    <= {{ var('headway_tol_ratio', 0.5) }} then 1
                else 0
            end
        ) as headway_adherence_rate,
        approx_quantiles(obs_headway_sec, 100)[offset(50)] as obs_headway_sec_p50,
        approx_quantiles(obs_headway_sec, 100)[offset(90)] as obs_headway_sec_p90
    from headways
    group by
        stop_id,
        service_date_mst,
        event_hour_mst
),
agg as (
    select
        stop_id,
        service_date_mst,
        event_hour_mst,
        count(*) as n_events,
        avg(
            case
                when delay_sec is null then null
                when delay_sec > -{{ var('on_time_early_sec', 60) }}
                    and delay_sec <= {{ var('on_time_late_sec', 300) }} then 1
                else 0
            end
        ) as pct_on_time,
        avg(delay_sec) as mean_delay_sec,
        approx_quantiles(delay_sec, 100)[offset(90)] as p90_delay_sec,
        if(count(distinct data_version) > 1, 'mixed', any_value(data_version)) as data_version,
        countif(delay_sec is not null) as n_reported_events,
        safe_divide(countif(within_30s), count(*)) as pct_within_30s,
        safe_divide(
            countif(arrival_method like '%crossing%' or arrival_method = 'origin_departure'),
            count(*)
        ) as pct_shape_crossing
    from base
    group by
        stop_id,
        service_date_mst,
        event_hour_mst
),
route_mode as (
    select
        stop_id,
        service_date_mst,
        event_hour_mst,
        array_agg(route_id order by route_events desc, route_id limit 1)[offset(0)] as route_id_mode
    from (
        select
            stop_id,
            service_date_mst,
            event_hour_mst,
            route_id,
            count(*) as route_events
        from base
        where route_id is not null
        group by
            stop_id,
            service_date_mst,
            event_hour_mst,
            route_id
    )
    group by
        stop_id,
        service_date_mst,
        event_hour_mst
)

select
    a.stop_id,
    a.service_date_mst,
    a.event_hour_mst,
    a.n_events,
    a.pct_on_time,
    a.mean_delay_sec,
    a.p90_delay_sec,
    coalesce(rm.route_id_mode, 'unknown') as route_id_mode,
    h.headway_adherence_rate,
    h.obs_headway_sec_p50,
    h.obs_headway_sec_p90,
    current_timestamp() as build_run_at,
    s.stop_name,
    s.lat,
    s.lon,
    r.route_name as route_name_mode,
    a.data_version,
    a.n_reported_events,
    a.pct_within_30s,
    a.pct_shape_crossing
from agg as a
left join head as h
    using (stop_id, service_date_mst, event_hour_mst)
left join route_mode as rm
    using (stop_id, service_date_mst, event_hour_mst)
left join {{ ref('dim_stop') }} as s
    on s.stop_id = a.stop_id
    and s.is_latest_version
left join {{ ref('dim_route') }} as r
    on r.route_id = rm.route_id_mode
    and r.is_latest_version

        array_agg(route_id order by route_events desc, route_id limit 1)[offset(0)] as route_id_mode
    from (

            event_hour_mst,
            route_id,

        where route_id is not null

            event_hour_mst,
            route_id

    group by
        stop_id,
        service_date_mst,
        event_hour_mst

    a.stop_id,

    a.event_hour_mst,

    current_timestamp() as build_run_at,

    a.data_version,

    a.pct_within_30s,
    a.pct_shape_crossing
from agg as a
left join head as h
    using (stop_id, service_date_mst, event_hour_mst)
left join route_mode as rm
    using (stop_id, service_date_mst, event_hour_mst)
left join `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`dim_stop` as s
    on s.stop_id = a.stop_id
    and s.is_latest_version
left join `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`dim_route` as r
    on r.route_id = rm.route_id_mode

model.whyline_denver_dbt.mart_transit_la.description: Weekly running speed on each Denver transit-lane corridor beside the same routes' segments without a lane, by period. Every lane in the city's layer predates WhyLine's data, so this is cross-sectional until a lane opens with a date set in var('lane_openings').

corridor.name: corridor
corridor.description: Lane corridor name from Denver's layer (trimmed).

segment_group.name: segment_group
segment_group.description: lane (the corridor's lane segments) or same_routes_no_lane (segments of the routes that use the lane, where there is no lane).

period.name: period
period.description: early, am_peak, midday, pm_peak, evening or night, by departure hour.

p50_delay_ratio.name: p50_delay_ratio
p50_delay_ratio.description: Median running time over scheduled running time; below 1 is faster than scheduled.

first_year_built.name: first_year_built
first_year_built.description: Earliest build year among the corridor's lanes.

last_year_built.name: last_year_built
last_year_built.description: Latest build year among the corridor's lanes.

weeks_since_opening.name: weeks_since_opening
weeks_since_opening.description: Weeks from the opening date set in var('lane_openings'); NULL when no date is set.

model.whyline_denver_dbt.mart_transit_la.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='table', meta={"allow_in_app": false}) }}

{#
Did the bus lane help? Weekly running speed on each transit-lane corridor beside the same routes'
segments that have no lane, by period. Every Denver lane in the city's layer was built by 2022,
before WhyLine's timed data starts (2026-10-28), so a before-and-after needs a lane that opens
later: set its date in var('lane_openings', {'Corridor name': 'YYYY-MM-DD'}) and
weeks_since_opening fills in. Until then the comparison is cross-sectional: lane segments are on
downtown streets that differ from the comparison segments in more than the lane.
#}
{% set openings = var('lane_openings', {}) %}

with lane_segments as (
    select from_stop_id, to_stop_id, corridor, lane_type, year_built
    from {{ ref('bridge_segment_transit_lane') }}
),
traversals as (
    select
        t.*,
        date_trunc(t.service_date, week(monday)) as week_start,
        case
            when t.depart_hour_mst between 4 and 6 then 'early'
            when t.depart_hour_mst between 7 and 8 then 'am_peak'
            when t.depart_hour_mst between 9 and 14 then 'midday'
            when t.depart_hour_mst between 15 and 17 then 'pm_peak'
            when t.depart_hour_mst between 18 and 20 then 'evening'
            else 'night'
        end as period,
        safe_divide(t.travel_sec, nullif(t.scheduled_travel_sec, 0)) as delay_ratio
    from {{ ref('fct_segment_traversal') }} as t
),
on_lane as (
    select distinct l.corridor, t.route_id
    from traversals as t
    join lane_segments as l
        on l.from_stop_id = t.from_stop_id and l.to_stop_id = t.to_stop_id
),
grouped as (
    -- The corridor's own lane segments.
    select l.corridor, 'lane' as segment_group, t.week_start, t.period, t.speed_kmh, t.delay_ratio
    from traversals as t
    join (select distinct from_stop_id, to_stop_id, corridor from lane_segments) as l
        on l.from_stop_id = t.from_stop_id and l.to_stop_id = t.to_stop_id
    union all
    -- The same routes elsewhere, on segments with no lane at all.
    select r.corridor, 'same_routes_no_lane', t.week_start, t.period, t.speed_kmh, t.delay_ratio
    from traversals as t
    join on_lane as r
        on r.route_id = t.route_id
    where not exists (
        select 1 from lane_segments as l
        where l.from_stop_id = t.from_stop_id and l.to_stop_id = t.to_stop_id
    )
),
lane_years as (
    select corridor, min(year_built) as first_year_built, max(year_built) as last_year_built
    from lane_segments
    group by 1
)

select
    g.corridor,
    g.segment_group,
    g.week_start,
    g.period,
    count(*) as n_traversals,
    approx_quantiles(g.speed_kmh, 100)[offset(50)] as p50_speed_kmh,
    approx_quantiles(g.delay_ratio, 100)[offset(50)] as p50_delay_ratio,
    any_value(y.first_year_built) as first_year_built,
    any_value(y.last_year_built) as last_year_built,
    {% if openings %}
    case g.corridor
        {%- for corridor, opened in openings.items() %}
        when '{{ corridor }}' then date_diff(g.week_start, date '{{ opened }}', week(monday))
        {%- endfor %}
    end as weeks_since_opening,
    {% else %}
    cast(null as int64) as weeks_since_opening,
    {% endif %}
    current_timestamp() as build_run_at
from grouped as g
left join lane_years as y
    using (corridor)
group by 1, 2, 3, 4

model.whyline_denver_dbt.mart_reported_v.name: mart_reported_vs_measured_by_month
model.whyline_denver_dbt.mart_reported_v.description: RTD's reported monthly on-time performance beside WhyLine's measured share for the same month: all bus, light rail, A/B/G commuter lines and the N Line. RTD measures at timepoints with its own rules; WhyLine at every stop it times, 1 minute early to 5 minutes late.

rtd_pct_on_time.name: rtd_pct_on_time
rtd_pct_on_time.description: RTD's reported on-time performance for the month (0-1); NULL until RTD publishes it.

rtd_service_availability.name: rtd_service_availability
rtd_service_availability.description: RTD's reported service availability (0-1), where reported.

whyline_pct_on_time.name: whyline_pct_on_time
whyline_pct_on_time.description: WhyLine's measured on-time share for the month (0-1); NULL before WhyLine measured it.

n_visits_measured.name: n_visits_measured
n_visits_measured.description: Stop visits with a known delay behind WhyLine's share.

n_days_measured.name: n_days_measured
n_days_measured.description: Service dates measured in the month.

model.whyline_denver_dbt.mart_reported_v.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='table', meta={"allow_in_app": false}) }}

{#
Why do WhyLine's numbers differ from RTD's? RTD's reported monthly on-time performance beside
WhyLine's measured share for the same month and service: all bus, light rail, the A, B and G
commuter lines, and the N Line. RTD measures at timepoints with its own rules; WhyLine at every
stop it times, 1 minute early to 5 minutes late. Months only overlap once WhyLine has measured
them (from 2026-10-28) and RTD has published them (about two months later). Local, Regional
and Regional BRT need RTD's route classification and aren't split. Published with release R3.
#}
with reported as (
    select
        report_month,
        service,
        round(max(if(metric = 'otp_month', value_pct, null)) / 100, 4) as rtd_pct_on_time,
        round(max(if(metric = 'service_availability', value_pct, null)) / 100, 4) as rtd_service_availability
    from {{ ref('fct_rtd_reported_performance') }}
    where service in ('all_bus', 'light_rail', 'commuter_rail_abg', 'commuter_rail_n')
    group by 1, 2
),
measured as (
    select
        date_trunc(v.service_date, month) as report_month,
        case
            when r.route_type = '3' then 'all_bus'
            when r.route_type = '0' then 'light_rail'
            when v.route_id = '117N' then 'commuter_rail_n'
            when r.route_type = '2' then 'commuter_rail_abg'
        end as service,
        count(*) as n_visits_measured,
        count(distinct v.service_date) as n_days_measured,
        avg(if(v.delay_sec > -{{ var('on_time_early_sec', 60) }} and v.delay_sec <= {{ var('on_time_late_sec', 300) }}, 1, 0))
            as whyline_pct_on_time
    from {{ ref('fct_stop_visit') }} as v
    join {{ ref('dim_route') }} as r
        on r.route_id = v.route_id
        and r.is_latest_version
    where v.delay_sec is not null
    group by 1, 2
)

select
    coalesce(r.report_month, m.report_month) as report_month,
    coalesce(r.service, m.service) as service,
    r.rtd_pct_on_time,
    r.rtd_service_availability,
    round(m.whyline_pct_on_time, 4) as whyline_pct_on_time,
    round(m.whyline_pct_on_time - r.rtd_pct_on_time, 4) as difference_pct_on_time,
    m.n_visits_measured,
    m.n_days_measured,
    current_timestamp() as build_run_at
from reported as r
full join measured as m
    on m.report_month = r.report_month
    and m.service = r.service
where coalesce(r.service, m.service) is not null

model.whyline_denver_dbt.mart_weather_im.description: On-time share by the weather in the hour the vehicle reached the stop, per route, over the last 90 service dates: precipitation band, snow falling or not, and temperature band, with the difference from the route's baseline level. Weather is modelled at the airport; association is not causation.

level.name: level
level.description: precipitation: none (<0.1 mm in the hour), light (<1), moderate (<4), heavy. snowfall: snowing or not_snowing. temperature: below_-10, -10_to_0, 0_to_30, 30_plus (C).

n_visits.name: n_visits
n_visits.description: Stop visits with a known delay in hours at this level.

pct_on_time.name: pct_on_time
pct_on_time.description: Share from 1 minute early to 5 minutes late.

delta_pct_on_time.name: delta_pct_on_time
delta_pct_on_time.description: pct_on_time minus the route's baseline (none, not_snowing or 0_to_30); NULL without a baseline.

model.whyline_denver_dbt.mart_weather_im.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='table', meta={"allow_in_app": false}) }}

{#
Reliability by the weather in the hour the vehicle reached the stop, per route, over the last
weather_hourly_window_days service dates: precipitation band, whether snow was falling, and
temperature band. delta_pct_on_time compares each level with the route's dry, not-snowing or
0-30 C baseline. Hourly weather is modelled at the airport, and association is not causation.
Published after the stop-visit review.
#}
{% set window_days = var('weather_hourly_window_days', 90) %}

with visits as (
    select
        v.route_id,
        if(v.delay_sec > -{{ var('on_time_early_sec', 60) }} and v.delay_sec <= {{ var('on_time_late_sec', 300) }}, 1, 0) as on_time,
        v.delay_sec,
        w.precip_mm,
        w.snowfall_mm,
        w.temp_c
    from {{ ref('fct_stop_visit') }} as v
    join {{ ref('fct_weather_hourly') }} as w
        on w.ts_utc = timestamp_trunc(v.arrival_ts_utc, hour)
        and w.station = '{{ var("weather_station") }}'
    where
        v.service_date >= date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval {{ window_days }} day)
        and v.delay_sec is not null
        and v.route_id is not null
),
levels as (
    select route_id, on_time, delay_sec, 'precipitation' as factor,
        case
            when precip_mm < 0.1 then 'none'
            when precip_mm < 1 then 'light'
            when precip_mm < 4 then 'moderate'
            else 'heavy'
        end as level
    from visits
    where precip_mm is not null
    union all
    select route_id, on_time, delay_sec, 'snowfall', if(snowfall_mm > 0, 'snowing', 'not_snowing')
    from visits
    where snowfall_mm is not null
    union all
    select route_id, on_time, delay_sec, 'temperature',
        case
            when temp_c < -10 then 'below_-10'
            when temp_c < 0 then '-10_to_0'
            when temp_c < 30 then '0_to_30'
            else '30_plus'
        end
    from visits
    where temp_c is not null
),
grouped as (
    select
        route_id,
        factor,
        level,
        count(*) as n_visits,
        avg(on_time) as pct_on_time,
        avg(delay_sec) as mean_delay_sec,
        approx_quantiles(delay_sec, 10)[offset(9)] as p90_delay_sec
    from levels
    group by 1, 2, 3
)

select
    *,
    pct_on_time - max(if(level in ('none', 'not_snowing', '0_to_30'), pct_on_time, null))
        over (partition by route_id, factor) as delta_pct_on_time,
    current_timestamp() as build_run_at
from grouped

model.whyline_denver_dbt.mart_priority_h.name: mart_priority_hotspots
model.whyline_denver_dbt.mart_priority_h.description: Composite priority ranking per stop that blends vulnerability, crash exposure, and reliability problems.

stop_id.name: stop_id
stop_id.description: GTFS stop identifier; joins to mart_gtfs_stops.stop_id.

priority_score.name: priority_score
priority_score.description: Priority = 0.5*vulnerability + 0.3*crash + 0.2*unreliability; missing component scores count as zero.

stop_name.name: stop_name
stop_name.description: Stop name from the latest GTFS version of this stop.

lat.name: lat
lat.description: Stop latitude (WGS84) from the latest GTFS version of this stop.

lon.name: lon
lon.description: Stop longitude (WGS84) from the latest GTFS version of this stop.

model.whyline_denver_dbt.mart_priority_h.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='table', meta={"allow_in_app": true}) }}

with rel as (
    select
        stop_id,
        100.0 * (1 - avg(pct_on_time)) as reliability_score_0_100
    from {{ ref('mart_reliability_by_stop_hour') }}
    -- Stop-visit days only, so a window that spans the cutover doesn't average the two methods.
    where data_version is not null
      and service_date_mst >= date_sub(current_date("America/Denver"), interval 35 day)
    group by stop_id
),
cr as (
    select
        stop_id,
        cast(
            round(
                (crash_250m_cnt - min(crash_250m_cnt) over ()) /
                nullif(
                    max(crash_250m_cnt) over () - min(crash_250m_cnt) over (),
                    0
                ) * 100,
                1
            ) as float64
        ) as crash_score_0_100
    from {{ ref('mart_crash_proximity_by_stop') }}
),
v as (
    select
        stop_id,
        vuln_score_0_100
    from {{ ref('mart_vulnerability_by_stop') }}
),
joined as (
    select
        coalesce(v.stop_id, cr.stop_id, rel.stop_id) as stop_id,
        v.vuln_score_0_100,
        cr.crash_score_0_100,
        rel.reliability_score_0_100
    from v
    full outer join cr
        using (stop_id)
    full outer join rel
        using (stop_id)
),
scored as (
    select
        stop_id,
        vuln_score_0_100,
        crash_score_0_100,
        reliability_score_0_100,
        0.5 * coalesce(vuln_score_0_100, 0)
        + 0.3 * coalesce(crash_score_0_100, 0)
        + 0.2 * coalesce(reliability_score_0_100, 0) as priority_score
    from joined
)

select
    sc.stop_id,
    sc.vuln_score_0_100,
    sc.crash_score_0_100,
    sc.reliability_score_0_100,
    sc.priority_score,
    dense_rank() over (order by sc.priority_score desc) as priority_rank,
    current_timestamp() as build_run_at,
    s.stop_name,
    s.lat,
    s.lon
from scored as sc
left join {{ ref('dim_stop') }} as s
    on s.stop_id = sc.stop_id

model.whyline_denver_dbt.mart_service_eq.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='table', meta={"allow_in_app": false}) }}

{#
Is service worse where the state and city prioritise? For Denver stops grouped by their block
group's Colorado EnviroScreen disproportionately impacted status and by Denver's DOTI equity
group (1 = highest need), over the last equity_window_days service dates: scheduled departures
per stop per day, on-time share, excess wait at frequent stops, and the share of visits arriving
with standing room only or worse. Missed trips are trip-level and not split here. Published with
release R2.
#}
{% set window_days = var('equity_window_days', 28) %}
{% set since = "date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval " ~ window_days ~ " day)" %}
{% set until = "date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day)" %}

with stop_groups as (
    select sb.stop_id, 'disproportionately_impacted' as group_type,
        if(bg.is_disproportionately_impacted, 'impacted', 'not_impacted') as group_value
    from {{ ref('bridge_stop_block_group') }} as sb
    join {{ ref('dim_block_group') }} as bg on bg.block_group_key = sb.block_group_key
    union all
    select sb.stop_id, 'doti_equity_group', cast(bg.doti_equity_group_rank as string)
    from {{ ref('bridge_stop_block_group') }} as sb
    join {{ ref('dim_block_group') }} as bg on bg.block_group_key = sb.block_group_key
    where bg.doti_equity_group_rank is not null
),
departures as (
    select stop_id, count(*) / count(distinct service_date_mst) as departures_per_day
    from {{ ref('fct_scheduled_stop_time') }}
    where service_date_mst between {{ since }} and {{ until }}
    group by 1
),
headways as (
    select
        stop_id,
        if(scheduled_headway_sec between 1 and 900, observed_headway_sec, null) as h,
        if(observed_headway_sec is not null and scheduled_headway_sec between 1 and 900, scheduled_headway_sec, null) as s,
        if(delay_sec is null, null,
            if(delay_sec > -{{ var('on_time_early_sec', 60) }} and delay_sec <= {{ var('on_time_late_sec', 300) }}, 1, 0)) as on_time
    from {{ ref('fct_stop_headway') }}
    where service_date between {{ since }} and {{ until }}
),
crowding as (
    select stop_id, max_level
    from {{ ref('fct_trip_occupancy') }}
    where service_date between {{ since }} and {{ until }} and max_level is not null
),
by_group as (
    select g.group_type, g.group_value, count(distinct g.stop_id) as n_stops,
        round(avg(d.departures_per_day), 1) as avg_departures_per_stop_day
    from stop_groups as g
    left join departures as d using (stop_id)
    group by 1, 2
),
wait as (
    select
        g.group_type,
        g.group_value,
        avg(h.on_time) as pct_on_time,
        safe_divide(sum(h.h * h.h), 2 * sum(h.h)) - safe_divide(sum(h.s * h.s), 2 * sum(h.s)) as excess_wait_sec
    from headways as h
    join stop_groups as g using (stop_id)
    group by 1, 2
),
crowd as (
    select g.group_type, g.group_value, avg(if(c.max_level >= 3, 1, 0)) as pct_visits_standing_or_worse
    from crowding as c
    join stop_groups as g using (stop_id)
    group by 1, 2
)

select
    b.group_type,
    b.group_value,
    b.n_stops,
    b.avg_departures_per_stop_day,
    w.pct_on_time,
    w.excess_wait_sec,
    c.pct_visits_standing_or_worse,
    current_timestamp() as build_run_at
from by_group as b
left join wait as w using (group_type, group_value)
left join crowd as c using (group_type, group_value)

model.whyline_denver_dbt.mart_frequent_n.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='table', meta={"allow_in_app": true}) }}

{#
Span and frequency per route, direction and day type, measured at each direction's busiest stop
(the most scheduled departures that day), so short turns count. "Frequent" follows TransitCenter:
every 15 minutes or better from 6:00 to 21:00 on all three day types, tested as at least 12
departures in each three-hour block, so a departure slipping past a clock hour doesn't count against it.
#}
with sample_dates as (
    {{ schedule_sample_dates() }}
),
stop_hours as (
    select
        d.day_type,
        d.sample_date,
        s.route_id,
        s.direction_id,
        s.stop_id,
        {{ hour_mst('s.sched_departure_ts_mst') }} as hour_mst,
        count(*) as n_departures,
        min(s.sched_departure_ts_mst) as first_departure_ts,
        max(s.sched_departure_ts_mst) as last_departure_ts
    from {{ ref('fct_scheduled_stop_time') }} as s
    join sample_dates as d
        on s.service_date_mst = d.sample_date
    where
        s.service_date_mst between current_date('America/Denver')
        and date_add(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 13 day)
    group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
),
trunk_stop as (
    select
        day_type,
        route_id,
        direction_id,
        stop_id
    from stop_hours
    group by 1, 2, 3, 4
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by day_type, route_id, direction_id
        order by sum(n_departures) desc, stop_id
    ) = 1
),
trunk_hours as (
    select h.*
    from stop_hours as h
    join trunk_stop as t
        using (day_type, route_id, direction_id, stop_id)
),
-- Blocks with no departure at all count as zero for the frequency test.
blocks as (
    select block from unnest(generate_array(0, 4)) as block
),
block_counts as (
    select
        day_type,
        route_id,
        direction_id,
        div(hour_mst - 6, 3) as block,
        sum(n_departures) as n_departures
    from trunk_hours
    where hour_mst between 6 and 20
    group by 1, 2, 3, 4
),
frequency as (
    select
        t.day_type,
        t.route_id,
        t.direction_id,
        min(coalesce(c.n_departures, 0)) as min_departures_per_3h
    from (select distinct day_type, route_id, direction_id from trunk_hours) as t
    cross join blocks as b
    left join block_counts as c
        on c.day_type = t.day_type
        and c.route_id = t.route_id
        and c.direction_id = t.direction_id
        and c.block = b.block
    group by 1, 2, 3
),
-- Frequent only when every direction is frequent on all three day types.
route_flags as (
    select
        route_id,
        logical_and(min_departures_per_3h >= 12) and count(distinct day_type) = 3 as is_frequent_route
    from frequency
    group by 1
),
per_direction as (
    select
        h.day_type,
        h.sample_date,
        h.route_id,
        h.direction_id,
        h.stop_id as busiest_stop_id,
        sum(h.n_departures) as n_departures_busiest_stop,
        format_datetime('%H:%M', {{ as_mst('min(h.first_departure_ts)') }}) as first_departure,
        format_datetime('%H:%M', {{ as_mst('max(h.last_departure_ts)') }}) as last_departure,
        round(timestamp_diff(max(h.last_departure_ts), min(h.first_departure_ts), minute) / 60, 1) as span_hours,

model.whyline_denver_dbt.mart_service_in.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='table', meta={"allow_in_app": true}) }}

{#
Scheduled service near each tract on the sample weekday. A stop's departures are shared among the
tracts within 804.672 m by population (bridge_stop_tract weights sum to 1 per stop), so tract
totals add up to the network total. Frequent stops have at least 4 departures in every hour from
9:00 to 14:59.
#}
with weekday_sample as (
    select sample_date
    from ({{ schedule_sample_dates() }})
    where day_type = 'weekday'
),
stop_hours as (
    select
        s.stop_id,
        {{ hour_mst('s.sched_departure_ts_mst') }} as hour_mst,
        count(*) as n_departures
    from {{ ref('fct_scheduled_stop_time') }} as s
    join weekday_sample as d
        on s.service_date_mst = d.sample_date
    where
        s.service_date_mst between current_date('America/Denver')
        and date_add(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 13 day)
    group by 1, 2
),
stops as (
    select
        stop_id,
        sum(n_departures) as n_departures,
        -- Hours with no departure make the stop infrequent.
        count(distinct if(hour_mst between 9 and 14 and n_departures >= 4, hour_mst, null)) = 6 as is_frequent_stop
    from stop_hours
    group by 1
)

select
    b.geoid,
    any_value(b.tract_pop_total) as tract_pop_total,
    (select w.sample_date from weekday_sample as w) as sample_date,
    count(distinct b.stop_id) as n_stops_nearby,
    count(distinct if(s.is_frequent_stop, b.stop_id, null)) as n_frequent_stops_nearby,
    round(sum(coalesce(s.n_departures, 0) * b.weighting_factor), 1) as weekday_departures_share,
    round(
        safe_divide(sum(coalesce(s.n_departures, 0) * b.weighting_factor), any_value(b.tract_pop_total) / 1000),
        1
    ) as weekday_departures_per_1000_residents,
    current_timestamp() as build_run_at
from {{ ref('bridge_stop_tract') }} as b
left join stops as s
    using (stop_id)
group by 1

model.whyline_denver_dbt.mart_stop_score.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='table', cluster_by=['stop_id'], meta={"allow_in_app": false}) }}

{#
"How is my stop doing?" One row per current stop, over the last scorecard_window_days service
dates where a measure is time-based: scheduled service, measured reliability and wait, prediction
accuracy, crowding, safety, access, alerts in effect, equity context and nearby scooters and
bikes. Each measured component comes with its count; a missing component stays NULL, never 0.
Reads the published marts where they already hold the answer. Published with release R4.
#}
{% set window_days = var('scorecard_window_days', 28) %}
{% set since = "date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval " ~ window_days ~ " day)" %}
{% set until = "date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day)" %}

with stops as (
    select stop_id, stop_name, lat, lon
    from {{ ref('dim_stop') }}
    where is_current
),
service as (
    select
        stop_id,
        string_agg(distinct route_id, ',' order by route_id) as weekday_route_ids,
        sum(n_departures) as weekday_departures
    from {{ ref('mart_service_frequency_by_stop') }}
    where day_type = 'weekday'
    group by 1
),
reliability as (
    select
        stop_id,
        count(*) as n_visits_measured,
        avg(if(delay_sec is null, null,
            if(delay_sec > -{{ var('on_time_early_sec', 60) }} and delay_sec <= {{ var('on_time_late_sec', 300) }}, 1, 0))) as pct_on_time,
        safe_divide(
            sum(if(scheduled_headway_sec between 1 and 900, pow(observed_headway_sec, 2), null)),
            2 * sum(if(scheduled_headway_sec between 1 and 900, observed_headway_sec, null))
        ) - safe_divide(
            sum(if(observed_headway_sec is not null and scheduled_headway_sec between 1 and 900, pow(scheduled_headway_sec, 2), null)),
            2 * sum(if(observed_headway_sec is not null and scheduled_headway_sec between 1 and 900, scheduled_headway_sec, null))
        ) as excess_wait_sec,
        avg(if(observed_headway_sec is null or not scheduled_headway_sec between 1 and 900, null,
            if(observed_headway_sec < 0.25 * scheduled_headway_sec, 1, 0))) as pct_bunched
    from {{ ref('fct_stop_headway') }}
    where service_date between {{ since }} and {{ until }}
    group by 1
),
predictions as (
    select
        stop_id,
        countif(has_prediction and horizon_bucket = '0-3') as n_predictions_0_3,
        avg(if(has_prediction and horizon_bucket = '0-3', if(within_band, 1, 0), null)) as pct_predictions_accurate_0_3,
        avg(if(has_prediction and horizon_bucket = '6-12', if(within_band, 1, 0), null)) as pct_predictions_accurate_6_12
    from {{ ref('fct_prediction_accuracy') }}
    where service_date between {{ since }} and {{ until }}
    group by 1
),
crowding as (
    select
        stop_id,
        countif(max_level is not null) as n_visits_with_occupancy,
        avg(if(max_level is null, null, if(max_level >= 3, 1, 0))) as pct_arrivals_standing_or_worse
    from {{ ref('fct_trip_occupancy') }}
    where service_date between {{ since }} and {{ until }}
    group by 1
),
alerts as (
    select stop_id, countif(is_active_now) as n_alerts_in_effect, countif(is_active_now and is_closure) as n_closures_in_effect
    from {{ ref('mart_stop_closures') }}
    group by 1
),
jobs as (
    -- Population-weighted over the Denver tracts within 804.672 m (bridge_stop_tract).
    select b.stop_id, round(sum(cast(b.weighting_factor as float64) * j.jobs_reachable)) as jobs_within_45min_am_peak
    from {{ ref('bridge_stop_tract') }} as b
    join {{ ref('fct_job_access') }} as j
        on j.geoid = b.geoid
        and j.departure_window = 'weekday_am_peak'
        and j.minutes_threshold = 45
    group by 1
),
micromobility as (

with stops as (
    select stop_id, stop_name, lat, lon
    from `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`dim_stop`
    where is_current
),
service as (
    select
        stop_id,
        string_agg(distinct route_id, ',' order by route_id) as weekday_route_ids,
        sum(n_departures) as weekday_departures
    from `whyline-denver`.`mart_denver`.`mart_service_frequency_by_stop`
    where day_type = 'weekday'
    group by 1
),
reliability as (
    select
        stop_id,
        count(*) as n_visits_measured,
        avg(if(delay_sec is null, null,
            if(delay_sec > -60 and delay_sec <= 300, 1, 0))) as pct_on_time,
        safe_divide(
            sum(if(scheduled_headway_sec between 1 and 900, pow(observed_headway_sec, 2), null)),
            2 * sum(if(scheduled_headway_sec between 1 and 900, observed_headway_sec, null))
        ) - safe_divide(
            sum(if(observed_headway_sec is not null and scheduled_headway_sec between 1 and 900, pow(scheduled_headway_sec, 2), null)),
            2 * sum(if(observed_headway_sec is not null and scheduled_headway_sec between 1 and 900, scheduled_headway_sec, null))
        ) as excess_wait_sec,
        avg(if(observed_headway_sec is null or not scheduled_headway_sec between 1 and 900, null,
            if(observed_headway_sec < 0.25 * scheduled_headway_sec, 1, 0))) as pct_bunched
    from `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`fct_stop_headway`
    where service_date between date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 28 day) and date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day)
    group by 1
),
predictions as (
    select
        stop_id,
        countif(has_prediction and horizon_bucket = '0-3') as n_predictions_0_3,
        avg(if(has_prediction and horizon_bucket = '0-3', if(within_band, 1, 0), null)) as pct_predictions_accurate_0_3,
        avg(if(has_prediction and horizon_bucket = '6-12', if(within_band, 1, 0), null)) as pct_predictions_accurate_6_12
    from `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`fct_prediction_accuracy`
    where service_date between date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 28 day) and date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day)
    group by 1
),
crowding as (
    select
        stop_id,

    from `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`fct_trip_occupancy`
    where service_date between date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 28 day) and date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day)

    group by 1
),
jobs as (

from stops as s

{{ config(materialized='table', meta={"allow_in_app": false}) }}

{#
"Report card for route 15": one row per route, both directions together, over the last
scorecard_window_days service dates: scheduled frequency and span, on-time share and excess wait,
delivered and likely-missed trips, prediction accuracy, crowding, run-time reliability and alert
hours. Each measured component comes with its count; a missing component stays NULL, never 0.
Published with release R4.
#}
{% set window_days = var('scorecard_window_days', 28) %}
{% set since = "date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval " ~ window_days ~ " day)" %}
{% set until = "date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day)" %}

with routes as (
    select route_id, route_name, route_long_name
    from {{ ref('dim_route') }}
    where is_latest_version and route_id is not null
),
schedule as (
    select
        route_id,
        logical_and(is_frequent_route) as is_frequent_route,
        min(if(day_type = 'weekday', first_departure, null)) as weekday_first_departure,
        max(if(day_type = 'weekday', last_departure, null)) as weekday_last_departure,
        avg(if(day_type = 'weekday', headway_midday_min, null)) as weekday_midday_headway_min
    from {{ ref('mart_frequent_network_by_route') }}
    group by 1
),
reliability as (
    select
        route_id,
        count(*) as n_visits_measured,
        avg(if(delay_sec is null, null,
            if(delay_sec > -{{ var('on_time_early_sec', 60) }} and delay_sec <= {{ var('on_time_late_sec', 300) }}, 1, 0))) as pct_on_time,
        safe_divide(
            sum(if(scheduled_headway_sec between 1 and 900, pow(observed_headway_sec, 2), null)),
            2 * sum(if(scheduled_headway_sec between 1 and 900, observed_headway_sec, null))
        ) - safe_divide(
            sum(if(observed_headway_sec is not null and scheduled_headway_sec between 1 and 900, pow(scheduled_headway_sec, 2), null)),
            2 * sum(if(observed_headway_sec is not null and scheduled_headway_sec between 1 and 900, scheduled_headway_sec, null))
        ) as excess_wait_sec
    from {{ ref('fct_stop_headway') }}
    where service_date between {{ since }} and {{ until }}
    group by 1
),
delivery as (
    select
        route_id,
        sum(n_scheduled) as n_trips_scheduled,
        sum(n_observable) as n_trips_observable,
        safe_divide(sum(pct_delivered * n_observable), sum(if(pct_delivered is null, 0, n_observable))) as pct_delivered,
        safe_divide(sum(pct_missed_likely * n_observable), sum(if(pct_missed_likely is null, 0, n_observable)))
            as pct_missed_likely
    from {{ ref('mart_service_delivered_by_route_day') }}
    where service_date_mst between {{ since }} and {{ until }}
    group by 1
),
predictions as (
    select
        route_id,
        avg(if(has_prediction and horizon_bucket = '0-3', if(within_band, 1, 0), null)) as pct_predictions_accurate_0_3
    from {{ ref('fct_prediction_accuracy') }}
    where service_date between {{ since }} and {{ until }}
    group by 1
),
crowding as (
    select
        route_id,
        count(*) as n_trips_with_occupancy,
        avg(if(trip_level >= 3, 1, 0)) as pct_trips_standing_or_worse
    from (
        select service_date, trip_id, any_value(route_id) as route_id, max(max_level) as trip_level
        from {{ ref('fct_trip_occupancy') }}
        where service_date between {{ since }} and {{ until }}
        group by 1, 2
    )
    where trip_level is not null
    group by 1
),
runtime as (
    select
        route_id,
        sum(n_trips) as n_trips_timed,
        round(safe_divide(sum(buffer_time_index * n_trips), sum(n_trips)), 3) as buffer_time_index
    from {{ ref('mart_trip_runtime_by_route_day') }}
    where service_date_mst between {{ since }} and {{ until }}
    group by 1
),
alerts as (
    select route_id, round(sum(alert_hours), 1) as alert_hours
    from {{ ref('mart_alerts_by_route_day') }}
    where service_date_mst between {{ since }} and {{ until }}
    group by 1
)

select
    r.route_id,
    r.route_name,
    r.route_long_name,
    s.is_frequent_route,
    s.weekday_first_departure,
    s.weekday_last_departure,
    round(s.weekday_midday_headway_min, 1) as weekday_midday_headway_min,
    rl.n_visits_measured,
    rl.pct_on_time,
    rl.excess_wait_sec,
    d.n_trips_scheduled,
    d.n_trips_observable,
    d.pct_delivered,
    d.pct_missed_likely,
    p.pct_predictions_accurate_0_3,
    c.n_trips_with_occupancy,
    c.pct_trips_standing_or_worse,
    rt.n_trips_timed,
    rt.buffer_time_index,
    a.alert_hours,
    current_timestamp() as build_run_at
from routes as r
left join schedule as s using (route_id)
left join reliability as rl using (route_id)
left join delivery as d using (route_id)
left join predictions as p using (route_id)
left join crowding as c using (route_id)
left join runtime as rt using (route_id)
left join alerts as a using (route_id)

analysis.whyline_denver_dbt.backfill_exp.raw_code:
-- One-off export for the stop-visit backfill (owner-run; writes Parquet to GCS, creates no tables).
-- Compile: dbt compile --select backfill_export
--          --vars '{stream_start_date: "YYYY-MM-DD", backfill_export_uri: "gs://BUCKET/backfill/export"}'
-- Run:     bq query --use_legacy_sql=false < dbt/target/compiled/whyline_denver_dbt/analyses/backfill_export.sql
-- Then:    python -m whyline.ingest.gtfs_rt_backfill --export <uri> --from 2025-10-23 --until <stream start - 1>
-- Dry runs (2026-10-28): old trip updates 11.2 GiB and vehicle positions 0.8 GiB over the whole range
-- (about 0.08 GiB per daily statement), schedule extract per date 1.7 GiB, ingestion log 0.01 GiB, static
-- extracts about 0.06 GiB per distinct feed version. With the 10 MB minimum on each of the ~740 daily
-- statements, about 19 GiB in all, inside the monthly free tier. Runtime: roughly 1-2 hours.
DECLARE start_date DATE DEFAULT DATE '2025-10-23';
DECLARE end_date DATE DEFAULT DATE_SUB(DATE '{{ var("stream_start_date", "2100-01-01") }}', INTERVAL 1 DAY);
DECLARE uri STRING DEFAULT '{{ var("backfill_export_uri", "gs://SET-ME") }}';
DECLARE extracts ARRAY<DATE>;

IF STARTS_WITH(uri, 'gs://SET-ME') OR end_date >= CURRENT_DATE() THEN
    RAISE USING MESSAGE = 'Set stream_start_date (first full stream day) and backfill_export_uri.';
END IF;

-- Static GTFS: the extract the schedule used on each service date, each file at its latest load on or
-- before that extract, deduplicated by file content (ingestion-log hashes) so an unchanged feed exports once.
CREATE TEMP TABLE file_hashes AS
SELECT
    `table` AS tbl,
    SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', REGEXP_EXTRACT(_source_path, r'extract_date=(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})')) AS file_extract,
    ANY_VALUE(_hash_md5) AS hash
FROM `{{ source('raw', 'raw_gtfs_stops').database }}.{{ source('raw', 'raw_gtfs_stops').schema }}.__ingestion_log`
WHERE `table` IN ('raw_gtfs_stops', 'raw_gtfs_routes', 'raw_gtfs_trips', 'raw_gtfs_stop_times', 'raw_gtfs_shapes')
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING file_extract IS NOT NULL;

CREATE TEMP TABLE service_extract AS
SELECT service_date_mst AS service_date, ANY_VALUE(gtfs_extract_date) AS extract_date
FROM {{ ref('fct_scheduled_stop_time') }}
WHERE service_date_mst BETWEEN start_date AND end_date
GROUP BY 1;

CREATE TEMP TABLE version_files AS
SELECT e.extract_date, f.tbl, MAX(f.file_extract) AS file_extract
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT extract_date FROM service_extract) AS e
JOIN file_hashes AS f ON f.file_extract <= e.extract_date
GROUP BY 1, 2;

CREATE TEMP TABLE versions AS

-- One-off export for the stop-visit backfill (owner-run; writes Parquet to GCS, creates no tables).
-- Compile: dbt compile --select backfill_export
--          --vars '{stream_start_date: "YYYY-MM-DD", backfill_export_uri: "gs://BUCKET/backfill/export"}'
-- Run:     bq query --use_legacy_sql=false < dbt/target/compiled/whyline_denver_dbt/analyses/backfill_export.sql
-- Then:    python -m whyline.ingest.gtfs_rt_backfill --export <uri> --from 2025-10-23 --until <stream start - 1>
-- Dry runs (2026-10-28): old trip updates 11.2 GiB and vehicle positions 0.8 GiB over the whole range
-- (about 0.08 GiB per daily statement), schedule extract per date 1.7 GiB, ingestion log 0.01 GiB, static
-- extracts about 0.06 GiB per distinct feed version. With the 10 MB minimum on each of the ~740 daily
-- statements, about 19 GiB in all, inside the monthly free tier. Runtime: roughly 1-2 hours.
DECLARE start_date DATE DEFAULT DATE '2025-10-23';
DECLARE end_date DATE DEFAULT DATE_SUB(DATE '2100-01-01', INTERVAL 1 DAY);
DECLARE uri STRING DEFAULT 'gs://SET-ME';
DECLARE extracts ARRAY<DATE>;

IF STARTS_WITH(uri, 'gs://SET-ME') OR end_date >= CURRENT_DATE() THEN
    RAISE USING MESSAGE = 'Set stream_start_date (first full stream day) and backfill_export_uri.';
END IF;

-- Static GTFS: the extract the schedule used on each service date, each file at its latest load on or
-- before that extract, deduplicated by file content (ingestion-log hashes) so an unchanged feed exports once.
CREATE TEMP TABLE file_hashes AS
SELECT
    `table` AS tbl,
    SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', REGEXP_EXTRACT(_source_path, r'extract_date=(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})')) AS file_extract,
    ANY_VALUE(_hash_md5) AS hash
FROM `whyline-denver.raw_denver.__ingestion_log`
WHERE `table` IN ('raw_gtfs_stops', 'raw_gtfs_routes', 'raw_gtfs_trips', 'raw_gtfs_stop_times', 'raw_gtfs_shapes')
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING file_extract IS NOT NULL;

CREATE TEMP TABLE service_extract AS
SELECT service_date_mst AS service_date, ANY_VALUE(gtfs_extract_date) AS extract_date
FROM `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`fct_scheduled_stop_time`
WHERE service_date_mst BETWEEN start_date AND end_date
GROUP BY 1;

CREATE TEMP TABLE version_files AS
SELECT e.extract_date, f.tbl, MAX(f.file_extract) AS file_extract
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT extract_date FROM service_extract) AS e
JOIN file_hashes AS f ON f.file_extract <= e.extract_date
GROUP BY 1, 2;

SELECT extract_date, MIN(extract_date) OVER (PARTITION BY content) AS static_version
FROM (
    SELECT v.extract_date, TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(v.tbl, h.hash) ORDER BY v.tbl)) AS content
    FROM version_files AS v
    JOIN file_hashes AS h ON h.tbl = v.tbl AND h.file_extract = v.file_extract
    GROUP BY 1
);

analysis.whyline_denver_dbt.backfill_cal.name: backfill_calibration
analysis.whyline_denver_dbt.backfill_cal.raw_code:
-- Calibration of backfill_v1 against stream_v1, run after 2-4 weeks of stream data (owner-run):
-- 1. Replay the archive thinned to one refresh per 15 minutes, without vehicle stop fields, in backfill mode:
--    make replay-gtfs-rt REPLAY_SOURCE=gs://whylinedenver-rt-archive FROM=<d1> UNTIL=<d2> REPLAY_OUT=data/calibration \
--      REPLAY_FLAGS="--thin-minutes 15 --strip-vp-stop-fields --engine-mode backfill --window-minutes 1440"
-- 2. gcloud storage cp -r data/calibration/snapshot_at=* gs://whylinedenver-raw/raw/rtd_gtfsrt_calibration/
-- 3. python -m whyline.load.bq_load --src gcs --bucket whylinedenver-raw --from <d1> --until <d2>
-- 4. dbt compile --select backfill_calibration --vars '{calibration_from: "<d1>", calibration_until: "<d2>"}'
--    and run the compiled SQL. Record the results in docs/public/METRICS_GLOSSARY.md before publishing
--    backfilled metrics.
-- Ground truth: stream shape_crossing visits (bracketing reports at most 30 s apart).
-- error_sec = backfill-method estimate minus stream estimate (positive: the backfill runs late).
{% set d1 = var('calibration_from', '2100-01-01') %}
{% set d2 = var('calibration_until', '2100-01-01') %}

with stream as (
    select service_date, trip_id, stop_sequence, route_id, arrival_ts_utc, arrival_hour_mst
    from {{ ref('fct_stop_visit') }}
    where service_date between date '{{ d1 }}' and date '{{ d2 }}'
      and data_version = 'stream_v1'
      and arrival_method = 'shape_crossing'
),
thinned as (
    select service_date, trip_id, stop_sequence, arrival_ts_utc, arrival_method, low_confidence,
        timestamp_diff(arrival_latest_ts, arrival_earliest_ts, second) as window_sec
    from {{ source('raw', 'raw_gtfsrt_stop_visits_calibration') }}
    where service_date between date '{{ d1 }}' and date '{{ d2 }}'
      and arrival_ts_utc is not null
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by service_date, trip_id, stop_sequence order by _ingested_at desc
    ) = 1
),
paired as (
    select
        s.*,
        coalesce(t.arrival_method, 'not_recovered') as backfill_method,
        t.low_confidence,
        t.window_sec,
        timestamp_diff(t.arrival_ts_utc, s.arrival_ts_utc, second) as error_sec
    from stream as s
    left join thinned as t using (service_date, trip_id, stop_sequence)
)

select
    coalesce(backfill_method, 'all') as backfill_method,
    count(*) as n_stream_visits,
    round(count(*) / (select count(*) from stream), 4) as share_of_stream_visits,
    approx_quantiles(abs(error_sec), 100)[offset(50)] as median_abs_error_sec,
    approx_quantiles(abs(error_sec), 100)[offset(90)] as p90_abs_error_sec,
    round(avg(error_sec), 1) as bias_sec,
    approx_quantiles(window_sec, 100)[offset(50)] as median_window_sec,
    countif(low_confidence) as n_low_confidence
from paired
group by rollup (backfill_method)
order by n_stream_visits desc

test.whyline_denver_dbt.assert_stop_visi.raw_code:
{{ config(severity='warn') }}

-- Within a trip, a later stop should not be reached more than a minute before an earlier one.
-- Warn-level: a regression points at a projection or attribution problem, not a load failure.
with visits as (
    select
        service_date,
        trip_id,
        stop_sequence,
        arrival_ts_utc,
        lag(arrival_ts_utc) over (
            partition by service_date, trip_id order by stop_sequence
        ) as previous_arrival_ts
    from {{ ref('fct_stop_visit') }}
    where service_date >= date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 2 day)
      and arrival_ts_utc is not null
)

select *
from visits
where arrival_ts_utc < timestamp_sub(previous_arrival_ts, interval 60 second)

test.whyline_denver_dbt.assert_stream_vi.name: assert_stream_visits_reach_fact
test.whyline_denver_dbt.assert_stream_vi.raw_code:
-- Raw stream partitions expire after 90 days and fct_stop_visit is the permanent copy, so every
-- stream visit must reach the fact long before then. Checks the rows loaded in a two-hour slice
-- two days ago (raw is partitioned by load hour, so this stays a few MB).
select r.service_date, r.trip_id, r.stop_sequence, r._ingested_at
from {{ ref('stg_rt_stop_visits') }} as r
left join {{ ref('fct_stop_visit') }} as f
    on f.service_date = r.service_date
    and f.trip_id = r.trip_id
    and f.stop_sequence = r.stop_sequence
    and f.service_date >= date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 7 day)
where r._ingested_at >= timestamp_sub(current_timestamp(), interval 50 hour)
  and r._ingested_at < timestamp_sub(current_timestamp(), interval 48 hour)
  and r.data_version = 'stream_v1'
  and r.service_date >= date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 7 day)
  and f.trip_id is null

macro.whyline_denver_dbt.gtfs_date_spine.name: gtfs_date_spine
macro.whyline_denver_dbt.gtfs_date_spine.macro_sql:
{% macro gtfs_date_spine(start_date, end_date) %}
{#
Generate a date spine for GTFS schedule expansion.
Creates all dates between start_date and end_date with day-of-week info.
#}
with date_array as (
    select
        generate_date_array(
            {{ start_date }},
            {{ end_date }},
            interval 1 day
        ) as dates
),
unnested as (
    select date_value
    from date_array
    cross join unnest(dates) as date_value
)
select
    date_value as service_date,
    case extract(dayofweek from date_value)
        when 1 then 'sunday'
        when 2 then 'monday'
        when 3 then 'tuesday'
        when 4 then 'wednesday'
        when 5 then 'thursday'
        when 6 then 'friday'
        when 7 then 'saturday'
    end as day_of_week,
    extract(dayofweek from date_value) = 1 as is_sunday,
    extract(dayofweek from date_value) = 2 as is_monday,
    extract(dayofweek from date_value) = 3 as is_tuesday,
    extract(dayofweek from date_value) = 4 as is_wednesday,
    extract(dayofweek from date_value) = 5 as is_thursday,
    extract(dayofweek from date_value) = 6 as is_friday,
    extract(dayofweek from date_value) = 7 as is_saturday
from unnested
{% endmacro %}

macro.whyline_denver_dbt.scd2_from_extra.name: scd2_from_extracts
macro.whyline_denver_dbt.scd2_from_extra.macro_sql:
{% macro scd2_from_extracts(relation, key, attrs, sk_name) %}
{#
Type 2 versions of `key` from a silver model that keeps every GTFS extract (`_extract_date`).
A new version starts on the first extract where any of `attrs` changed. The first version is
backdated to 1900-01-01 so older facts resolve; a key missing from the latest extract keeps
its last version, ending on the last extract that contained it.
#}
{%- set attr_list = attrs | join(', ') -%}
with versions_in as (
    select
        {{ key }},
        _extract_date,
        {{ attr_list }},
        to_json_string(struct({{ attr_list }})) as attr_sig
    from {{ relation }}
),
flagged as (
    select
        *,
        if(attr_sig = lag(attr_sig) over (partition by {{ key }} order by _extract_date), 0, 1) as is_change
    from versions_in
),
numbered as (
    select
        *,
        sum(is_change) over (
            partition by {{ key }} order by _extract_date rows unbounded preceding
        ) as version_num
    from flagged
),
grouped as (
    select
        {{ key }},
        version_num,
        {%- for attr in attrs %}
        any_value({{ attr }}) as {{ attr }},
        {%- endfor %}
        min(_extract_date) as first_seen_extract,
        max(_extract_date) as last_seen_extract
    from numbered
    group by {{ key }}, version_num
),
bounded as (
    select
        *,
        if(version_num = 1, date '1900-01-01', first_seen_extract) as valid_from,
        lead(first_seen_extract) over (partition by {{ key }} order by version_num) as next_valid_from,
        max(last_seen_extract) over () as latest_extract
    from grouped
)
select
    farm_fingerprint(concat(cast({{ key }} as string), '|', cast(valid_from as string))) as {{ sk_name }},
    {{ key }},
    {{ attr_list }},
    valid_from,
    case
        when next_valid_from is not null then date_sub(next_valid_from, interval 1 day)
        when last_seen_extract = latest_extract then date '9999-12-31'
        else last_seen_extract
    end as valid_to,
    next_valid_from is null and last_seen_extract = latest_extract as is_current,
    next_valid_from is null as is_latest_version,
    first_seen_extract,
    last_seen_extract
from bounded
{% endmacro %}

macro.whyline_denver_dbt.alert_intervals.name: alert_intervals
macro.whyline_denver_dbt.alert_intervals.macro_sql:
{% macro alert_intervals() %}
{#
Each alert's informed entities with the interval they were affected, from the alert's last
snapshot (so RTD's later edits win). Start: the period start, else when the alert was first seen.
End: the period end; once the alert has left the feed (last seen over 30 minutes before the
newest snapshot), no later than 15 minutes after it was last seen. NULL end means still open.
#}
    select
        p.alert_id,
        p.route_id,
        p.direction_id,
        p.stop_id,
        p.trip_id,
        a.cause,
        a.effect,
        a.header_text,
        a.last_seen_ts < timestamp_sub(n.newest_ts, interval 30 minute) as has_ended,
        coalesce(p.active_start_utc, a.first_seen_ts) as start_ts,
        case
            when a.last_seen_ts < timestamp_sub(n.newest_ts, interval 30 minute)
                then least(
                    coalesce(p.active_end_utc, timestamp_add(a.last_seen_ts, interval 15 minute)),
                    timestamp_add(a.last_seen_ts, interval 15 minute)
                )
            else p.active_end_utc
        end as end_ts
    from {{ ref('fct_alert_entity_period') }} as p
    join {{ ref('fct_alert') }} as a
        on a.alert_id = p.alert_id
        and p.last_seen_ts = a.last_seen_ts
    cross join (select max(last_seen_ts) as newest_ts from {{ ref('fct_alert') }}) as n
{% endmacro %}

{% macro _bigquery__get_table_shards_sql(information_schema) %}
    select
        tables.project_id as table_catalog,
        tables.dataset_id as table_schema,
        coalesce(REGEXP_EXTRACT(tables.table_id, '^(.+)[0-9]{8}$'), tables.table_id) as table_name,

        REGEXP_CONTAINS(tables.table_id, '^.+[0-9]{8}$') and tables.type = 1 as is_date_shard,
        case
            when materialized_views.table_name is not null then 'materialized view'
            when tables.type = 1 then 'table'
            when tables.type = 2 then 'view'
            else 'external'
        end as table_type,
        tables.type = 1 as is_table,
        JSON_VALUE(table_description.option_value) as table_comment,
        tables.size_bytes,
        tables.row_count
    from {{ information_schema.replace(information_schema_view='__TABLES__') }} tables
    left join {{ information_schema.replace(information_schema_view='MATERIALIZED_VIEWS') }} materialized_views
        on materialized_views.table_catalog = tables.project_id
        and materialized_views.table_schema = tables.dataset_id
        and materialized_views.table_name = tables.table_id
    left join {{ information_schema.replace(information_schema_view='TABLE_OPTIONS') }} table_description
        on table_description.table_catalog = tables.project_id
        and table_description.table_schema = tables.dataset_id
        and table_description.table_name = tables.table_id
        and table_description.option_name = 'description'

{% macro _bigquery__get_tables_sql() %}

macro.dbt_bigquery._bigquery__get_table_.name: _bigquery__get_table_stats_sql
macro.dbt_bigquery._bigquery__get_table_.macro_sql:
{% macro _bigquery__get_table_stats_sql() %}
    select
        table_catalog,
        table_schema,
        table_name,
        max(shard_name) as latest_shard_name,
        min(shard_index) as shard_min,
        max(shard_index) as shard_max,
        count(shard_index) as shard_count,
        sum(size_bytes) as size_bytes,
        sum(row_count) as row_count
    from table_shards
    group by 1, 2, 3
{% endmacro %}

macro.dbt_bigquery._bigquery__get_column.name: _bigquery__get_columns_sql
macro.dbt_bigquery._bigquery__get_column.macro_sql:
{% macro _bigquery__get_columns_sql(information_schema) %}
    select
        columns.table_catalog,
        columns.table_schema,
        columns.table_name as shard_name,
        coalesce(paths.field_path, '<unknown>') as column_name,
        -- invent a row number to account for nested fields
        -- BQ does not treat these nested properties as independent fields
        row_number() over (
            partition by
                columns.table_catalog,
                columns.table_schema,
                columns.table_name
            order by
                columns.ordinal_position,
                paths.field_path
        ) as column_index,
        coalesce(paths.data_type, '<unknown>') as column_type,
        paths.description as column_comment,
        case when columns.is_partitioning_column = 'YES' then 1 else 0 end as is_partitioning_column,
        case when columns.is_partitioning_column = 'YES' then paths.field_path end as partition_column,
        case when columns.clustering_ordinal_position is not null then 1 else 0 end as is_clustering_column,
        case when columns.clustering_ordinal_position is not null then paths.field_path end as cluster_column,
        columns.clustering_ordinal_position
    from {{ information_schema.replace(information_schema_view='COLUMNS') }} columns
    join {{ information_schema.replace(information_schema_view='COLUMN_FIELD_PATHS') }} paths
        on paths.table_catalog = columns.table_catalog
        and paths.table_schema = columns.table_schema
        and paths.table_name = columns.table_name
        and paths.column_name = columns.column_name
    where columns.ordinal_position is not null
{% endmacro %}

macro.dbt_bigquery._bigquery__get_column.name: _bigquery__get_column_stats_sql
macro.dbt_bigquery._bigquery__get_column.macro_sql:
{% macro _bigquery__get_column_stats_sql() %}
    select
        table_catalog,
        table_schema,
        shard_name,
        max(is_partitioning_column) = 1 as is_partitioned,
        max(partition_column) as partition_column,
        max(is_clustering_column) = 1 as is_clustered,
        array_to_string(
            array_agg(
                cluster_column ignore nulls
                order by clustering_ordinal_position
            ), ', '
        ) as clustering_columns
    from columns
    group by 1, 2, 3
{% endmacro %}

macro.dbt_bigquery._bigquery__get_extend.name: _bigquery__get_extended_catalog_sql
macro.dbt_bigquery._bigquery__get_extend.macro_sql:
{% macro _bigquery__get_extended_catalog_sql() %}
    select
        tables.table_catalog as table_database,
        tables.table_schema,
        case
            when tables.is_date_shard then concat(tables.table_name, '*')
            else tables.table_name
        end as table_name,
        tables.table_type,
        tables.table_comment,
        -- coalesce column metadata fields to ensure they are non-null for catalog generation
        -- external table columns are not present in COLUMN_FIELD_PATHS
        coalesce(columns.column_name, '<unknown>') as column_name,
        coalesce(columns.column_index, 1) as column_index,
        coalesce(columns.column_type, '<unknown>') as column_type,
        coalesce(columns.column_comment, '') as column_comment,

        'Shard count' as `stats__date_shards__label`,
        table_stats.shard_count as `stats__date_shards__value`,
        'The number of date shards in this table' as `stats__date_shards__description`,
        tables.is_date_shard as `stats__date_shards__include`,

        'Shard (min)' as `stats__date_shard_min__label`,
        table_stats.shard_min as `stats__date_shard_min__value`,
        'The first date shard in this table' as `stats__date_shard_min__description`,
        tables.is_date_shard as `stats__date_shard_min__include`,

        'Shard (max)' as `stats__date_shard_max__label`,
        table_stats.shard_max as `stats__date_shard_max__value`,
        'The last date shard in this table' as `stats__date_shard_max__description`,
        tables.is_date_shard as `stats__date_shard_max__include`,

        '# Rows' as `stats__num_rows__label`,
        table_stats.row_count as `stats__num_rows__value`,
        'Approximate count of rows in this table' as `stats__num_rows__description`,
        tables.is_table as `stats__num_rows__include`,

        'Approximate Size' as `stats__num_bytes__label`,
        table_stats.size_bytes as `stats__num_bytes__value`,
        'Approximate size of table as reported by BigQuery' as `stats__num_bytes__description`,
        tables.is_table as `stats__num_bytes__include`,

        'Partitioned By' as `stats__partitioning_type__label`,
        column_stats.partition_column as `stats__partitioning_type__value`,
        'The partitioning column for this table' as `stats__partitioning_type__description`,
        column_stats.is_partitioned as `stats__partitioning_type__include`,

        'Clustered By' as `stats__clustering_fields__label`,
        column_stats.clustering_columns as `stats__clustering_fields__value`,
        'The clustering columns for this table' as `stats__clustering_fields__description`,
        column_stats.is_clustered as `stats__clustering_fields__include`

    from tables
    join table_stats
        on table_stats.table_catalog = tables.table_catalog
        and table_stats.table_schema = tables.table_schema
        and table_stats.table_name = tables.table_name
    left join column_stats
        on column_stats.table_catalog = tables.table_catalog
        and column_stats.table_schema = tables.table_schema
        and column_stats.shard_name = table_stats.latest_shard_name
    left join columns
        on columns.table_catalog = tables.table_catalog
        and columns.table_schema = tables.table_schema
        and columns.shard_name = table_stats.latest_shard_name
{% endmacro %}
